acceptDispute.description: Accepts a chargeback: you won't contest it, and the disputed amount stays with the buyer. The dispute becomes `lost`, and Flint sends `dispute.lost`. You can accept while `status` is `needs_response` and `is_action_required` is `true`. An inquiry can't be accepted; refund the payment or respond with evidence instead. Accepting can't be undone. Requires `payments.disputes.write`. Send no body or `{}`. If you don't receive a response, retry with the same idempotency key, or read the dispute: `status: lost` means it was accepted.

acceptFulfillment.description: Accepts pending fulfillment work so preparation can begin. Read supported_actions for actions available now. occurred_at records when the action occurred; on complete it also records completion evidence. expected_version optionally rejects a stale fulfillment version. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

acceptPartnerAppPlatformTerms.description: Records that the authenticated credential accepted the current version of Flint's platform terms for the app: the signed-in user for a Dashboard session, or the API key. Flint also records the time, IP address and user agent. supported_actions lists accept_platform_terms while the current version isn't accepted. Accepting a version the app already accepted returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied. When this meets the app's last platform requirement, platform.status becomes pending_review in the same write and Flint sends partner_app.updated.

adjustGiftCardBalance.description: Posts a relative correction with a typed reason and separate administrative authority. Corrections cannot consume reserved funds, exceed funding limits, or replace linked refunds and purchase reversals. expected_version fences the gift card version.

advanceOnboarding.description: Submits whatever the caller currently knows, re-evaluates onboarding, reconciles onboarding requirements, and returns the next step in the consolidated onboarding state machine. Send an empty JSON object when the current next_step only asks to refresh onboarding requirements. The credential selects the environment; the onboarding session token acts in the merchant's default sandbox. A partner install token can't send profile.email, and in live mode works only while its app's merchant_onboarding platform capability is active; otherwise it gets 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with the reason its platform status gives: platform_onboarding_required, platform_pending_review, platform_rejected, or platform_capability_inactive.

advanceTestClock.description: Sandbox only. Moves the test clock forward to `frozen_at`. Flint accepts the request and returns the clock in status `advancing`, then moves the clock's customers and their subscriptions to `frozen_at`, running the billing that falls due along the way, in order. Flint sends `test_clock.ready` when the advance finishes, or `test_clock.failed` if it can't finish. You can also read the clock with `GET /v1/test-clocks/{test_clock_id}` until its status is `ready` or `failed`. One advance reaches at most two years, or two billing intervals of any subscription on the clock that isn't canceled, whichever is earlier.

applyInventoryCount.description: Sets inventory levels to the counted quantities of an open physical count. Every line needs an observation. VERSION_CONFLICT also covers a stale saved physical observation with no corresponding field in this request; these details omit param. Recount affected items and save the complete observations before applying again. Physical changes after observation require recounts, including at a trading location; holds and commitments alone do not invalidate observations. Call it only when apply is in supported_actions. Returns a result with inventory_count as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory count by ID.

applyOrderDiscount.description: Applies a promotion-backed or manual discount to an order. Checkout-authenticated buyers must provide a promotion code; resource IDs and manual discounts require merchant authentication.

applyOrderGiftCard.description: Selects a gift card by its current code and returns masked selections and an unreserved estimate. No value is held or debited. Optional expected_version must match the order version returned by the last read. An order may select at most 20 gift cards. Gift card value cannot pay for subscription orders. Retry a lost response with the same idempotency key to recover the original selection result.

applySubscriptionPromotion.description: Attaches a promotion to a subscription for future charged cycles. Send exactly one of promotion.promotion_id or promotion.promotion_code. first_cycle defaults to completed_cycles + 1, or completed_cycles + 2 while past_due, and cannot exceed completed_cycles + 120. Use replace_promotion_id to replace an active or scheduled promotion from first_cycle forward. The unpaid past_due order keeps its price. Promotion terms are frozen when attached; reattachment keeps consumed cycles. Offer promotions cannot be replaced. Requires commerce.subscriptions.write.

approvePaymentReview.description: Approves the payment and closes the review with `closed_reason: approved`. Approving never captures: capture a manual-capture payment yourself before `authorization_expires_at`. Approving a review you already approved returns it unchanged.

assignToUnconfiguredDeliveryProfile.description: Assigns this active delivery profile to physical product variants and bundle components that don't have one. Flint accepts the request with `202`, then assigns the profile in batches after responding. To know when it's done, poll `GET /v1/delivery-profiles/{delivery_profile_id}`, waiting at least `Retry-After` seconds between reads, until `unconfigured_assignment.status` is `completed`, `canceled`, or `failed`. Each item keeps `delivery_configuration_status` `action_required` until its batch commits, and each batch sends the `updated` events of the variants, products, and bundles it changes. An item that gets a profile from another write first keeps it. A newer assignment takes over from one still running, and the earlier one becomes `canceled` with `cancellation_reason` `superseded`. If the profile is archived before the assignment finishes, it becomes `canceled` with `cancellation_reason` `delivery_profile_archived` and the remaining items stay unconfigured.

authorizeCLIDevice.description: First-party public client flint-cli. Uses application/x-www-form-urlencoded and flat OAuth JSON. Repeated Authorization fields return 400 INVALID_REQUEST with a NOT_ALLOWED detail at Authorization in the Flint error envelope. No client secret or HTTP Basic authentication. Requests are not replayed through idempotency caching. Send session_mode=contexts for a session that supports additive reauthorization. The required scope field contains the full requested set as space-separated names. Login sends the scopes it needs, and login with extra permissions sends those plus the additions. No scopes are implicitly added. The browser may approve a subset per context; token scope reports the approved set. Unknown scopes return HTTP 400 invalid_scope. Selected scopes are checked against the selected merchant and environment before approval.

cancelFulfillment.description: Cancels fulfillment work that has not completed. Read supported_actions for actions available now. occurred_at records when the action occurred; on complete it also records completion evidence. expected_version optionally rejects a stale fulfillment version. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

cancelGiftCardNotification.description: Cancels a notification before sending starts or after confirmed failure. A sending or unconfirmed notification cannot be canceled. Gift card value is preserved.

cancelGiftCardRedemption.description: Releases an uncaptured standalone reservation without posting a debit or refund. Flint order reservations cannot be released while a processor outcome is unresolved. expected_version fences the redemption version.

cancelInventoryCount.description: Closes an open physical count without changing stock. Call it only when cancel is in supported_actions. Returns a result with inventory_count as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory count by ID.

cancelInventoryTransfer.description: Cancels requested quantity that hasn't departed. Call it only when cancel is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets, not deltas. Returns a result with inventory_transfer as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory transfer by ID.

cancelInvoicePaymentAttempt.description: Cancels an active invoice payment attempt and its payment intent. A processing ACH debit can be canceled only until the payment processor sends it to the bank; after that the request returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason in_progress and the attempt stays processing. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key. Accepts an empty body or {}.

cancelMerchantSignup.description: Cancels a `pending` signup and voids its code, so a code email still queued is never sent. A canceled signup returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied; any other status, including a signup Flint is completing after verify, returns reason unsupported_state with current_status. Live only: test credentials get 403 FORBIDDEN with reason live_mode_required, and a key linked to a partner app install gets 403 FORBIDDEN with reason linked_key_not_allowed. Partner app tokens can't call it.

cancelMeReturn.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Cancel a Return before any merchandise or value work commits. Cancellation is refused once a receipt, inspection, disposition, or resolution exists. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

cancelMeSubscription.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Cancels a subscription and records who asked, why, and when in cancellation_details. With cancel_immediately: true it ends now. Otherwise, trialing ends at trial_end_at, active at current_period_end_at (or now when a renewal delivery hold has expired), and past_due at next_retry_at instead of that retry. Scheduled, incomplete, paused, and past_due without next_retry_at require cancel_immediately: true or fail with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `period_end_unavailable`. Paid deliveries extend a scheduled cancellation to the last paid delivery when it is later. A merchant can cancel immediately without an automatic refund. A buyer cannot cancel immediately while prepaid deliveries remain and period-end cancellation is available; the refusal reason is `prepaid_deliveries_remaining`. Read scheduled_cancel_at for the scheduled end time. A buyer's cancellation follows the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

cancelOrderPaymentAttempt.description: Cancels an active order payment attempt, its unsettled payment legs, and its attempt-owned holds.

cancelPaymentIntent.description: Cancels a standalone or order-owned payment intent. Read supported_actions for the actions its stored state accepts. Canceling a hold moves all of capturable_money to released_money, and nothing is charged. A processing payment intent fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `in_progress`; refund a succeeded one instead. Flint derives the owning order payment attempt. A leg held by an active order payment attempt may be refused. Omitted cancellation_reason stays absent. A fresh request for a canceled or expired payment returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied; a same-key retry replays or recovers its original result. A checkout credential can cancel only its own order leg, with requested_by_customer or abandoned when a reason is supplied.

cancelPayout.description: Cancels an eligible payout before it leaves Flint-controlled processing and returns the resulting payout.

cancelReturn.description: Cancel a Return before any merchandise or value work commits. Cancellation is refused once a receipt, inspection, disposition, or resolution exists.

cancelReturnDisposition.description: Cancel a disposition that has not started its inventory effect. Cancellation is refused once the effect is processing.

cancelReturnLineItem.description: Cancel approved quantity on a Return line item. Quantity already received, inspected, dispositioned, or reserved by a resolution, including a failed one, cannot be canceled, and the conflict response names what is blocking it. Omit handback_quantity to lower the expected handback only as far as the canceled quantity requires. An explicit value cannot leave more merchandise expected than the remaining approved quantity.

cancelReturnResolution.description: Cancel a resolution and release the line value it reserved. A failed resolution can be canceled only when it never created a Refund, PaymentIntent, or Order, or when it is an unpaid exchange or replacement. Effects that already succeeded are undone with a compensating correction instead.

cancelSubscription.description: Cancels a subscription and records who asked, why, and when in cancellation_details. With cancel_immediately: true it ends now. Otherwise, trialing ends at trial_end_at, active at current_period_end_at (or now when a renewal delivery hold has expired), and past_due at next_retry_at instead of that retry. Scheduled, incomplete, paused, and past_due without next_retry_at require cancel_immediately: true or fail with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `period_end_unavailable`. Paid deliveries extend a scheduled cancellation to the last paid delivery when it is later. A merchant can cancel immediately without an automatic refund. A buyer cannot cancel immediately while prepaid deliveries remain and period-end cancellation is available; the refusal reason is `prepaid_deliveries_remaining`. Read scheduled_cancel_at for the scheduled end time. A buyer's cancellation follows the store's customer_account.buyer_capabilities. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change.

captureGiftCardRedemption.description: Posts the full reserved amount before the manual reservation expires. Capturing and expiry use the same concurrency fence. Flint order reservations are resolved by their payment attempt and cannot be captured through this standalone operation. expected_version fences the redemption version.

capturePaymentIntent.description: Captures a standalone or order-owned payment intent in requires_capture. Omit amount_money to capture all of capturable_money, or send a smaller amount for a partial capture. Send final_amount_money and tip_money instead to collect the final bill plus a tip in one charge; with request_overcapture and overcapture.status available, that total can exceed the authorization up to overcapture.maximum_capturable_money. On an order's payment, the bill is at most the payment's share of the order (its authorization minus its tip), the order releases the difference, and the tip becomes the payment's part of the order's tip. Flint releases the uncaptured remainder in the same request, and a payment intent can be captured only once. amount_money on the payment intent keeps the requested amount; captured_money and released_money record the result. Affirm payments can only be captured in full. Flint derives the owning order payment attempt; order_payment_attempt_id is not accepted. An expired authorization is refreshed before capture and refused with ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status or authorization_expired. A fresh request for an already captured payment returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied; a same-key retry replays or recovers its original result.

cashOutGiftCard.description: Records cash that the merchant attests it paid to the cardholder. Flint does not send cash. A freeze, restriction, or unresolved funding dispute blocks cash-out with ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason restricted; remove the restriction before retrying. The amount cannot exceed unreserved value or consume payment reservations; cash_out_reference identifies the cash disbursement the merchant made outside Flint. expected_version fences the gift card version.

changeMeSubscriptionPlan.description: Changes to a plan in the subscription's plan_change_options. Flint uses that option's billing_starts: now charges a new period with credit for unused paid item time and changes the plan only when payment succeeds; prorated_now charges the difference for the rest of the current period, keeps the period and anchor, and requires an unchanged interval; next_renewal changes the plan immediately without charging and keeps the current period and next billing date. Omit interval and quantity to keep their current values; the target plan must offer them. Requires a full buyer session and Idempotency-Key. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. Retry with the same key to recover the same result. Returns 200 including on decline, with the unchanged subscription, a closed unpaid order, and a failed order_payment_attempt. Inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error before trying again. The order and order_payment_attempt are null when billing starts at the next renewal. When the store cannot accept payments, a new payment fails with 409 MERCHANT_NOT_READY and reason processing_restricted. Changes billed at a future renewal remain available. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

changeMeSubscriptionQuantity.description: Changes the frozen adjustable subscription line within its min_quantity and max_quantity. Requires a full buyer session and Idempotency-Key. period_end schedules quantities for the next billing boundary using scheduled_plan_change; PATCH scheduled_plan_change to null to cancel. prorated_now charges the difference now for an eligible digital line and keeps the period and billing anchor. Physical quantities require period_end. Refuses with plan_change_scheduled while another change is pending. Retry with the same key to recover the original result. Returns 200 on decline with unchanged subscription; inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error. The order and order_payment_attempt are null for period_end or zero net charge. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. When the store cannot accept payments, a new payment fails with 409 MERCHANT_NOT_READY and reason processing_restricted. Changes billed at a future renewal remain available. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

changeSubscriptionPlan.description: Replaces the subscription's lines and recurring options with the active target plan's current terms. Paired lines keep their quantities unless line_items overrides them. Pair by the same plan line on the same plan, then variant or bundle, then the only line on each side. Unpaired target lines use their plan quantity. If an adjusted current line cannot be paired, send quantities for every target line; otherwise the request fails with quantity_not_carried before any change. With billing_starts next_renewal, changes terms now without charging and keeps the current period and next billing date. With billing_starts prorated_now, charges the new terms for the rest of the current period, less unused paid item credit, while keeping the billing period and anchor; the resulting interval must stay unchanged. With billing_starts now, charges a new period and credits unused paid item time after promotions; the plan changes only when payment succeeds. If the credit exceeds the new item charge, choose next_renewal. Omit interval and quantity to keep their current values; the target plan must offer them. Contract terms and existing recurring promotions are preserved. Requires Idempotency-Key; retry with the same key to recover the same result. Returns status 200 for a decline, with a closed unpaid order, failed order_payment_attempt, and unchanged subscription. Inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error and update the subscription payment method before trying again. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. After a confirmed CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION with billing_starts now, refresh the subscription and send a new Idempotency-Key.

changeSubscriptionQuantity.description: Changes the subscription quantity multiplier, existing line quantities, or both, with the chosen billing timing. billing_starts is required: prorated_now charges now, next_renewal changes quantities immediately without charging, and period_end schedules them for the next billing boundary in scheduled_plan_change. Cancel pending quantities with PATCH scheduled_plan_change: null. A pending change locks quantity edits with plan_change_scheduled. Keeps the current billing period, next billing date, anchor and completed cycles. Omitted quantities stay unchanged. Send quantity or 1 to 50 distinct line_items. With prorated_now, a shipping line cannot be changed, and quantity cannot be supplied when any subscription line ships. Physical quantities can use next_renewal or period_end. Digital line quantities can be changed on a subscription with other lines that ship; its shipping lines stay unchanged and this charge creates no shipment or shipping charge. Quantities that do not charge can still be updated with subscription PATCH or the line-item routes. Requires Idempotency-Key; retry with the same key to recover the original outcome. Returns 200 on decline with a closed unpaid order, failed order_payment_attempt, and unchanged subscription. Inspect order_payment_attempt.last_payment_error before trying again. The order and order_payment_attempt are null when the net charge is zero. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. If the outcome remains uncertain, retrieve the subscription and its orders; contact Flint support with the original key and request ID when those reads cannot establish the result.

checkDeliveryRateCallbackConnection.description: Sends a minimal signed probe to verify endpoint reachability and callback credentials without running a synthetic rate evaluation. The Idempotency-Key fingerprint includes the delivery_rate_callback_id path value and request body. A retry replays the original result even after the callback changes or is archived.

checkInTicket.description: Admits an issued ticket. Concurrent check-ins of one ticket admit it once: the others return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied and current_status checked_in. A stale expected_version returns 409 VERSION_CONFLICT first, so scanners usually omit it. With admission_code the check-in method is admission_code, and the code must be the ticket's current code: a wrong code returns 400 at admission_code and changes nothing. Without a code the method is manual. A voided ticket returns reason unsupported_state. There is no event-time window. The code is never returned or logged.

checkTaxCalculationCallbackConnection.description: Tax calculation callback configuration is scoped to the selected environment. Partner installation tokens are unsupported. Sends a signed connection_check request. A 2xx response succeeds unless it sets a Content-Type other than application/json or its body is larger than maximum_response_bytes. Runs for inactive and active callbacks without changing the circuit breaker.

closeCheckoutSession.description: Closes an open checkout session before it naturally expires.

closeGiftCard.description: Permanently closes a card with zero balance, no reservations, no unresolved restrictions and no pending purchase refunds. expected_version fences the gift card version.

closeOrder.description: Closes an open order and stops further payment. Cancels pending discounts, releases their reservations, and recalculates totals; canceled discounts remain visible with status: "canceled" but no longer reduce the total. Unused order-owned payment intents are canceled. When collected money remains refundable, send collected_money_behavior: keep to close and keep it, or refund it first with POST /v1/refunds and order_id. Closing does not refund money; refunds remain available afterwards. Closing is blocked while payment collection is in progress. To complete a zero-balance order as paid, use POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay. closed_reason and closed_at record why and when the order closed. The request body is optional. Send expected_version to reject a mutation based on an outdated order read.

collectInvoice.description: Charges the invoice's saved payment method or the supplied saved payment method. Send a caller-chosen idempotency key, and reuse it when you retry the same collection.

commitInventoryReservation.description: Commits held quantity, usually once the buyer pays. Commit before expires_at: after the deadline, commit returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason terminal_status. Call it only when commit is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets: resending targets already applied succeeds even after the reservation closes. Returns a result with inventory_reservation as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory reservation by ID.

completeFile.description: Completing a merchant_logo or merchant_icon file requires a live-mode credential or a Dashboard session in any selected environment. Test credentials fail with `FORBIDDEN` and reason `live_mode_required`. After PUT succeeds, complete the file to process its image. Returns the ready file; completing a ready file again returns it. Send no request body or {}. Completing before the bytes arrive returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason status_not_reached and current_status awaiting_upload. Attach the returned file_id as images[].file_id before expires_at, 24 hours after processing. Completion requires the purpose's write scope, with the same merchant-wide branding and environment boundaries as createFile. Partner install tokens need the same purpose scope; a live install token with merchants.profile.write can upload merchant_logo and merchant_icon. Idempotency is scoped to merchant, credential, environment, route, and file_id. A replay returns the original result; it does not extend upload or attachment deadlines. After a lost completion response, repeat this route with the same key and file_id.

completeFulfillment.description: Completes the fulfillment and records its completion time. Read supported_actions for actions available now. occurred_at records when the action occurred; on complete it also records completion evidence. expected_version optionally rejects a stale fulfillment version. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

completeReturn.description: Complete a Return whose completion_mode is manual. The call fails while completion_blockers is non-empty. Automatic Returns complete themselves when the final blocker clears.

confirmCheckoutSessionCustomerVerificati.description: Checks the code the buyer typed. A right code makes the checkout act for the customer with that email, and creates the customer, with a customer.created event, when none exists. The checkout can then save the buyer's card with save_payment_method on POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay, and list and pay with that customer's saved cards. The order's customer does not change until the payment succeeds. Only the checkout_auth_token in the response acts for that customer. Send it as the Bearer credential from then on. Every other credential for the session, including earlier checkout_auth_token values and hosted checkout links, keeps working for the checkout and acts for no customer, so it lists no saved cards and pays with none. A buyer who opens the link on another device confirms an email there to use them, and from then on only that device's new credential acts for a customer. If the response is lost after the code was accepted, the credential you sent still works. Send the same code again with it while the code is valid, which counts as another try and returns a new credential for the same customer, or request a new code. A wrong, expired, or replaced code fails with `INVALID_REQUEST` and an `INVALID_VALUE` detail on `code`, and so does a used code once the checkout was confirmed again, any code after its 5th try, any code for an email past its limit on wrong tries, or a code whose email's customer changed its email or was deleted after the code was sent. If the checkout stops offering saved payment details before the code is confirmed, such as when the merchant turns them off, the request fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `not_offered`. A credential that already acts for a customer fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `already_applied`, and confirming never replaces a customer the merchant named. Once the customer whose email the buyer confirmed changes that email or is deleted, the checkout acts for no customer, and the buyer can confirm the customer's new email or another one. A checkout opened from a checkout reminder link acts for no customer the buyer confirmed earlier, so its buyer confirms an email again. A texted code for saved details binds the checkout the same way, but the new credential opens only the cards saved with that number: it lists and pays with no card saved by email, and reads no customer details. A texted code checks once, so after a lost answer request a new code. A code for purpose confirm_saved_payment_method keeps the session's credential, so the response omits checkout_auth_token and carries payment_method_save on the checkout session. A texted code saves the card with the number when the number already opens the customer's saved details or the customer has none yet; otherwise payment_method_save.email_confirmation_required turns true, and an emailed code finishes the save. An emailed code alone saves the card by email. After success, a retry with the same idempotency key and code returns the stored answer and credential to any credential of the session. After failure, a retry checks the code again and counts as another try.

confirmCustomerVerification.description: Confirms the Flint-sent code and returns a verification that can link guest purchases for its customer. A confirmed verification expires in 15 minutes and can be redeemed once.

confirmMeEmailChangeRequest.description: Confirms possession of the current and new email addresses, then atomically updates the customer account in the selected merchant environment. Omit current_email_code only when current_email_confirmation_required is false. A successful confirmation signs the buyer out everywhere at this store: it revokes every customer session, buyer access grant, and Flint-hosted account session for the customer, including the session that made this request. Cards saved with Flint stay at the previous email unless a customer session that can access them sends move_flint_wallet: true. Those sessions receive flint_wallet_outcome when the previous email had saved cards. Sign the buyer in again with the new email.

confirmPaymentIntent.description: Confirms a standalone payment intent. For the first confirmation, send credential_type stripe_confirmation_token, token, payment_method, or reader with its matching credential; a missing credential returns INVALID_REQUEST. After the buyer completes current_payment_action, call this route again with credential_type attached to continue the same payment attempt. Flint confirms again only if the processor still requires it, and otherwise returns the current payment intent. Unverified fee fields are omitted. On a Tap to Pay reader, requires_action returns current_payment_action with action_type card_presentment and stripe.terminal_payment_intent. Retrieve, collect, and confirm that payment with the Stripe Terminal SDK, then confirm with credential_type attached to read the outcome. A decline leaves the payment requires_action with last_payment_error so the app can collect another card; cancel to give up. current_payment_action is null when no buyer action is needed. It can also be null while status is requires_action if Flint cannot produce the action yet; call confirm again with credential_type attached. Order-owned payment intents return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason order_owned and supported_actions; pay them through POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/pay using remediation.next_actions.

confirmReturnResolution.description: Confirm a proposed resolution and freeze its economic facts. Execution can remain pending behind line-qualified execution blockers.

connectTaxConnection.description: Records the seller's attestation and creates or completes the tax account from verified business details and the default line-item tax category in settings. Syncs registrations and removes tax-account copies of deleted registrations. Reconnect retains the tax account and does not turn the default tax setting back on. A rejected stored registration returns attention_required with registration_rejected. Successful configuration marks open calculated automatic-tax orders without an issued invoice incomplete and advances their versions. A same-key retry resumes setup without creating another account; unconfirmed account creation requires support. Retrieve the connection after a lost response.

consumeInventoryReservation.description: Consumes committed quantity when you hand the goods off, removing it from on-hand stock. Accepts provenance describing the handoff. Call it only when consume is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets: resending targets already applied succeeds even after the reservation closes. Returns a result with inventory_reservation as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory reservation by ID.

createAPIKey.description: Creates a merchant-bound external API key. A live credential creates a live key, or a test key bound to the sandbox named by sandbox_id. A sandbox-bound credential, such as a test key, creates test keys in its own sandbox only. An onboarding session creates its merchant's first keys here, in its default sandbox. secret_key is returned only in the initial successful response and accepted idempotent replays of the same create request.

createBundle.description: Creates a bundle: several product variants sold as one line at a single price. Send `name` and `unit_price_money`, and list the `components` (variants and quantities). An active bundle needs at least one component, every component must be active, and all components must share the same taxable setting and tax category. A SKU or barcode that another variant or bundle already uses fails with `ALREADY_EXISTS`.

createCategory.description: Creates a reusable category. If handle is omitted, Flint derives it from the name and never changes it on rename.

createCheckoutSession.description: Creates a hosted or headless checkout session for an order, quick-pay charge, subscription plan signup, a return resolution's buyer balance, or what is due now on an invoice. Subscription signup requires a buyer email before payment. Creation never implicitly replaces an open order session. To replace one, send order_id with replace_checkout_session_id set to the expected current session; the compare-and-swap replacement and collection-lock transfer commit atomically. Scopes depend on type: order, quick_pay and subscription_plan need checkouts.checkout_sessions.write, return_resolution needs commerce.returns.resolutions.write, and invoice needs commerce.invoices.write. A credential without the type's scope gets 403 INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE. A return_resolution or invoice session reuses the open session with the same surface and returns 200; a different surface replaces an idle session and is refused while a payment is in progress. Read the resolution or invoice with its own GET.

createCheckoutSessionCustomerVerificatio.description: Sends a six-digit code to prove the buyer controls an email address or mobile phone number, so this checkout can save a card, use saved details, or confirm a saved card. Only the session's own checkout credential can call it. A retry with the same idempotency key returns the same code request without sending another email or text. See the [headless checkout guide](https://developers.withflintpay.com/docs/guides/headless-checkout) for limits, sandbox codes, SMS copy, and what each answer reveals. To link guest purchases, use POST /v1/customer-verifications.

createCreditNote.description: Creates a draft credit note against an invoice that has been issued and not voided. Include line_items for initial corrections or omit them for an empty draft. The draft uses frozen invoice economics and the remaining pools shared by issued, non-void notes. Drafts reserve no credit. It receives a credit note number when issued.

createCreditNoteAllocation.description: Applies credit from an issued credit note to its invoice, reducing outstanding_money. The amount cannot exceed the credit note's available_money or the invoice's outstanding balance. Closing the balance with credit sets the invoice to paid when positive net collection remains, or credited when there is no positive net collection. Returns the allocation, the credit note, and the recomputed invoice together. An Idempotency-Key is required and becomes the allocation's identity.

createCustomDomain.description: Configures a checkout or customer account hostname in this environment. Remove an existing hostname of the same type before creating its replacement. If the create response is lost and a retry returns 500 IDEMPOTENCY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED, keep the original Idempotency-Key. List domains with GET /v1/custom-domains?type=customer_account and GET /v1/custom-domains?type=customer_account&status=archived, using type=checkout for both requests if that was the original type. Follow pagination and inspect current and archived domains for the requested hostname; use a matching domain's custom_domain_id to retrieve its current state. Do not switch keys or wait for key retention to expire to create again. Contact support with the request_id if the outcome is still unclear.

createCustomer.description: Creates a customer record for a buyer's contact details and purchases in this environment. When an active customer already has `email`, `on_email_conflict` chooses whether to fail with `ALREADY_EXISTS`, which names that customer, or return the existing customer unchanged. Emails match case-insensitively.

createCustomerAccessLink.description: Signs the buyer in to your Flint-hosted customer account as this customer. Works for 15 minutes and one open. The url is a bearer credential. Flint returns it only in this response and in a retry with the same idempotency key, so send it only to the buyer and keep it out of logs. A call with a new key creates another link; earlier links keep working until they expire. Optionally send return_url for a destination on your site, or omit the body. Requires customers.sessions.write. Idempotency is scoped to the merchant, credential, environment, and this customer's route. A replay returns the original link without extending its lifetime or replenishing its open. Without an idempotency key, each call creates a new link and has no replay result. If Flint cannot retain a result after minting, contact support with the request ID before sending a new request.

createCustomerAddress.description: Creates a stable saved address. The address becomes a default only when the request sets is_default_billing or is_default_shipping, or later by setting those flags with PATCH, including the customer's first address. A saved default becomes the customer's effective address for the corresponding role.

createCustomerDeletionRequest.description: Creates a deletion request for merchant review, or returns the customer's open request unchanged. No deletion work starts until approval.

createCustomerSession.description: Mints a server-side, customer-scoped credential after the merchant has authenticated the buyer. Keep secret and refresh_token on your server. For hosted sign-in, create a customer access link instead.

createCustomerTaxExemption.description: Records a nested customer exemption with reason, coverage and an inclusive date window. At most 100 unarchived exemptions may belong to a customer; exceeding that limit returns LIMIT_REACHED with reason customer_tax_exemptions. An active record applies to the customer's sales whose taxable destination its coverage contains, within its date range. Saving a record doesn't change the customer's blanket tax_exempt flag, which still takes precedence. Only API keys and dashboard sessions can access these records. Retry a lost response with the same request and Idempotency-Key. If IDEMPOTENCY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED is returned, inspect this customer's list and GET records before sending a new write. Match a lost create against submitted fields across list pages; contact support with the original key and request ID if its outcome is unclear.

createCustomerVerification.description: Sends a Flint verification code to the customer's current email for linking guest purchases. A customer without an email fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED`. Set purpose to link_guest_purchases; email is the only channel and the default. Confirm the code before linking purchases. Read its current status with GET /v1/customer-verifications/{customer_verification_id}. To prove an email inside a checkout, use POST /v1/checkout-sessions/{checkout_session_id}/customer-verifications.

createDeliveryLocationSet.description: Delivery location sets pin reusable sets of Locations for allocation or buyer pickup. Creation publishes immutable revision 1. It starts active.

createDeliveryMethod.description: Delivery methods combine eligibility, pricing, schedules, estimates, tax treatment, and execution behavior. Creation publishes immutable revision 1. Omit status to start inactive.

createDeliveryPreview.description: Computes delivery options with mode delivery_options or up to 25 pickup locations with mode pickup_locations. Creates no resource, holds no inventory, and does not change the current selection. Pickup locations are nearest first when a buyer location is provided. Merchant callers receive diagnostics. Checkout credentials may use only pickup_locations for their own checkout session.

createDeliveryProfile.description: Delivery profiles define reusable delivery rules assigned to catalog obligations. Creation publishes immutable revision 1. It starts active.

createDeliveryQuote.description: Creates an exact delivery quote for the checkout session named by checkout_session_id, without holding inventory. A checkout credential can quote only its own checkout session.

createDeliveryRateCallback.description: Delivery callback endpoints pin shared outbound callback transport configuration. Creation publishes immutable revision 1. signing_methods defaults to ["jwt"]. JWTs use Flint's public JWKS and this callback's delivery_rate_callback_id as aud. Verify body_sha256 against the exact request bytes. The jwt method sends Authorization: Bearer, and the hmac method sends webhook-signature and Flint-Signing-Key-Ids. Every request includes webhook-id and webhook-timestamp. When hmac is included, the response returns the shared secret and its delivery_rate_callback_signing_key_id once; no later response returns them. It starts inactive.

createDeliveryRateCallbackTestDelivery.description: Sends a signed delivery rate callback with synthetic non-PII data and returns a safe result. The Idempotency-Key fingerprint includes the delivery_rate_callback_id path value and request body. A retry replays the original result even after the callback changes or is archived.

createDeliveryRevocation.description: Permanently fences one exact delivery method revision, rate callback revision, callback HMAC signing key, or recorded Location geography version. Name both the parent and the exact child. Unknown targets return RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND without effects; a duplicate returns ALREADY_EXISTS with the existing revocation. Issued quotes are revoked immediately. Provisional selections are released before they can be used again.

createDeliverySelection.description: Selects one unexpired option per required choice group of delivery_quote_id. Replaces the checkout's provisional selection and stock hold, applies delivery charges, and returns the repriced order. Shipment and local delivery choices can keep a partial quote address when destination_address is omitted. Missing destination members and recipient fields appear in input_requirements and must be supplied by replacing the selection before payment. The selection acts on the quote's checkout session. A checkout credential can select only from quotes of its own checkout session; any other quote is refused as not found.

createDeliveryZone.description: Delivery zones define versioned geographic eligibility. Creation publishes immutable revision 1. It starts active.

createDemoSession.description: Creates a temporary demo sandbox and returns a short-lived test API key. The secret key is displayed only at creation time and for a short idempotent retry window. Omit template to use quickstart; an explicit empty or unsupported value is invalid.

createDevice.description: Creates a device. If an active device already has the hardware_fingerprint, fails with `ALREADY_EXISTS` and reason `hardware_fingerprint_already_exists`, and changes nothing. The details[0].current_resource field names the existing device.

createDiscountPreview.description: Evaluates promotion outcomes for an order without changing it. Returns the complete result inside data, without creating a resource or requiring an idempotency key. Use `promotion_id` for server-side apply flows where you already know the promotion, including code-gated promotions, which then apply without a code and count only toward the promotion's `max_uses`. Checkout credentials must use `promotion_code`. The response includes applied, skipped, and single-threshold available promotion candidates.

createDisputeResponseSession.description: Creates a browser session for responding to or viewing a dispute with Stripe Connect. Requires payments.disputes.write. Allowed for closed disputes; bank returns cannot be contested. Pass the returned payment to setPayment or the React payment prop. Each completed retry creates a fresh single-use client secret. Keep your API key on your server.

createFeedbackReport.description: Stores one immutable occurrence of Flint feedback. Use one report per root cause and include only the evidence needed to describe Flint's behavior.

createFile.description: Upload a local image to Flint. Create a file, PUT the bytes to upload.url with upload.method and every upload.headers value, then POST /v1/files/{file_id}/complete. The URL works for 15 minutes. Purpose requires its own write scope: product and product_variant use commerce.products.write; bundle uses commerce.bundles.write; payment_link uses checkouts.payment_links.write; subscription_plan uses commerce.subscription_plans.write; merchant_logo and merchant_icon use merchants.profile.write. Logo and icon files are merchant-wide. Creating or completing them requires a live-mode credential or a Dashboard session in any selected environment; test credentials fail with `FORBIDDEN` and reason `live_mode_required`. All other purposes belong to the authenticated environment. Partner install tokens need the same purpose scope; a live install token with merchants.profile.write can upload merchant_logo and merchant_icon. Idempotency is scoped to merchant, credential, environment, and route. A replay returns the original upload target without extending its expiry. After a lost response, retry with the same idempotency key or create another file. Each upload URL expires 15 minutes after creation.

createFulfillment.description: Creates a fulfillment for the specified quantities on a paid order. Idempotency-Key is required for every request because an inline shipped package can consume inventory. Save the key before sending and retry the same key and body after a lost response. GET /v1/fulfillments supports order_id and external_reference_id filters, but not idempotency_key; an empty list does not prove creation failed. If replay cannot recover the result, contact support with the original key and request ID instead of creating another fulfillment. A line that does not require fulfillment returns 400 INVALID_REQUEST with detail code NOT_ALLOWED at line_items[i].order_line_item_id; an unknown line ID returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND. Use this when you manage fulfillment outside checkout; checkout creates fulfillments for the buyer's delivery selections. While Flint is creating those fulfillments, requests for their quantities return OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS with reason delivery_selection_materializing. Retrieve the order and use its fulfillments. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `status_not_reached` when the order is not paid. See the [fulfillment guide](/docs/guides/fulfillment).

createFulfillmentEvent.description: Records an observational event for a fulfillment or one of its shipments or packages. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

createGiftCard.description: Creates a merchant-issued USD gift card with optional paid funding or imported opening value. External funding is merchant-attested and does not collect a payment. The full code is returned only by issuance or code replacement and their authorized retries for 24 hours, while that code remains current. Replacing a code ends recovery of that code. Financial command identity is retained for the lifetime of the ledger.

createGiftCardFundingDisposition.description: Accepts a confirmed funding dispute loss and honors all gift card value funded by that payment, including value restored to replacement cards. Records the dispute amount, original gift card consideration, honored value and preserved reservations. Clears only this dispute restriction; balances, unrelated restrictions and unresolved payment reservations remain intact. Requires gift card adjustment authority and a durable idempotency key.

createGiftCardLoad.description: Adds positive value with separately recorded consideration and funding provenance. Limits apply to externally funded value and imports as well as Flint-funded sales. Loading a pending card activates it; loading a frozen card does not remove its restrictions. expected_gift_card_version fences the gift card version.

createGiftCardNotification.description: Creates a recipient email notification, immediately or up to 90 days from now. A resend creates a new resource with resend_of_notification_id. An unconfirmed send must be resolved before another send is requested. Sending does not change gift card value or order fulfillment.

createGiftCardRedemption.description: Posts an exact amount automatically or reserves it for one full manual capture. Insufficient funds are rejected without a partial debit. Manual reservations default to 15 minutes and may be bounded up to 24 hours. External integrations coordinate and compensate their other tenders themselves. expected_gift_card_version fences the version of the card in gift_card_id.

createInventoryAdjustment.description: Record a stock change by what happened: stock received, returned, sold, stolen, lost, or moved between conditions, or an absolute count or correction. Flint computes the change against the current level. Returns the adjustment, its movement IDs, and the resulting level for every level touched. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory adjustments with the same idempotency_key, or list inventory movements with that idempotency_key.

createInventoryAllocationPolicy.description: Create an allocation policy with its routing configuration. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory allocation policies and identify the matching policy.

createInventoryCount.description: Open a physical count for selected inventory items at one Location. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory counts with the same idempotency_key.

createInventoryItem.description: Create an inventory item. SKU and barcode are searchable attributes, not identity: they are not required to be unique. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory items by the external_reference_id, sku, or barcode you supplied, then read the matching item.

createInventoryReceipt.description: Record returned units against a consumed inventory reservation and their disposition. For supplier deliveries, use POST /v1/inventory-adjustments with reason: received. This is a downstream stock effect, not the customer Return lifecycle. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory receipts with the same idempotency_key, or list inventory movements with that idempotency_key.

createInventoryReservation.description: Route standalone merchant demand and hold stock in one atomic command. A hold defaults to 15 minutes and can last up to 24 hours. Set expires_at when creating it or PATCH the reservation to change its deadline. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, list inventory reservations with the same idempotency_key.

createInventoryTransfer.description: Create a planned stock transfer between two Locations. Creates a draft and moves no stock, so an idempotency key is optional: each request without a key creates a separate draft. With a key, a retry must send the same request body, and idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. To recover a keyed create after a lost response, list inventory transfers with idempotency_key.

createInvoice.description: Creates an invoice draft from exactly one source: order_id for an order-backed invoice, or quick_pay for an invoice with a new backing order. Include issue to issue it immediately, using merchant_default delivery when issue is empty. An idempotency key is required for every request because issuing an automatic-collection invoice can charge the buyer. Replays preserve the original invoice result and recover its current public_url only within 24 hours of the original request; later replays omit public_url. Use GET /v1/invoices/{invoice_id} for the current invoice. If Flint returns IDEMPOTENCY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED, look up the original with GET /v1/invoices?idempotency_key={key}. Send the create again under a new key only after confirming it created no invoice, and contact Flint support with the request_id if you can't tell.

createInvoiceLateFee.description: Assesses the frozen late fee policy once per invoice or overdue schedule entry. The issued document remains unchanged.

createInvoiceManualPayment.description: Applies an offline/manual payment to an issued invoice. The monthly allowance for orders paid outside Flint never prevents recording a payment. When the order is above its current allowance, meta.warnings includes external_paid_orders_over_allowance with the order resource_id and the original usage period's resets_at. A replay preserves that original reset time. Recording is rejected with OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS while an online payment is still resolving; an idle open checkout does not block. A payment that clears the balance invalidates the open checkout session. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key.

createInvoicePaymentTerm.description: Creates a reusable payment term that decides when an invoice is due, for example on receipt, net days, or a day of the month. Send `name` and `calculation`. A late fee policy is optional; it applies to overdue invoices and is frozen on an invoice when the invoice is issued.

createLocation.description: Create a Location. Sending inventory_allocation_enabled also requires commerce.inventory.allocation.write. Omitted inventory_allocation_enabled defaults to false. Every Location can hold stock. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body.

createMeAddress.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Saves an address for the buyer. The address becomes a default only when the request sets is_default_billing or is_default_shipping, or later by setting those flags with PATCH, including the buyer's first address. A default address is also the billing or shipping address on the buyer's customer profile. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

createMeCheckoutSession.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Creates or reuses a hosted or headless checkout session for something the buyer owes. With type return_resolution, it collects the buyer's balance on one of their return resolutions' replacement order. With type invoice, it collects what is due now on one of the buyer's invoices; an invoice access token works for its own invoice only. The response is 200 when it reuses the open session with the same surface and 201 when it creates one. Omit surface to use hosted; changing surface replaces an idle session and is refused while a payment is in progress. Use redirects to set where the buyer goes after paying or canceling. The return_url field is an alias for redirects.success_url on hosted checkout or payment_return_url on headless checkout and must be an address of the merchant's customer account. A reused session takes a new success destination only until a payment starts, then keeps its existing destination. When the store cannot accept payments, a new payment fails with 409 MERCHANT_NOT_READY and reason processing_restricted. Changes billed at a future renewal remain available. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

createMeDeletionRequest.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Asks the store to delete the buyer's account, or returns the request already pending. The store approves or rejects it. Deletion anonymizes the customer: orders, payments, and refunds stay without the buyer's identity.

createMeEmailChangeRequest.description: Sends short-lived confirmation codes to the current and new email addresses. If the account has no current email, only the new address must be confirmed. The customer email does not change until confirmation succeeds. Limited to three attempts per 15 minutes, including attempts rejected because the email is already used. A rejected attempt keeps any pending email change request. Over the limit, the request fails with `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`; wait the whole seconds until the oldest counted attempt leaves the window, at least 1, before trying again.

createMeFlintWalletStoreSetup.description: Records the buyer's consent to save an independent store copy for off-session payments, including subscriptions. Call only after the buyer agrees. Requires a live email-code buyer login and an enabled Flint wallet at a Flint-hosted store account. Supply a flint_wallet_card_id from listMeFlintWalletCards. Confirm client_setup with Stripe.js confirmSetup, then poll GET /v1/me/payment-methods/{payment_method_id} until active before changing a subscription through PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id} with payment_method_id. Setup may request authentication. Removing the platform card or revoking store consent blocks the copy immediately. An idempotency key is optional and scoped to the store, customer, card handle, and key. Responses are retained for 24 hours. After a copy is revoked, retries with any key bound to that copy are refused. Get new consent and use a new key to create another copy. Retry a lost response with the same key. Concurrent requests for the same card at this store share one copy and setup. A failed off-session charge can still require the buyer to return through the existing card-update link. Accept an empty body or {}. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

createMePaymentMethod.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Starts saving a payment method for the buyer and returns the client setup to confirm in the browser. The payment method is pending until setup succeeds. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

createMerchantAccountSession.description: Creates an embedded browser handoff for one or more allowlisted account components. The credential selects the environment; the onboarding session token acts in the merchant's default sandbox. A partner install token works in live mode only while its app's merchant_onboarding platform capability is active; otherwise it gets 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with the reason its platform status gives: platform_onboarding_required, platform_pending_review, platform_rejected, or platform_capability_inactive. A same-key, same-input retry replays the encrypted original result for 24 hours, including its original credentials and expiries. Replay may return an expired credential. Use a new key for a new launch or refresh.

createMerchantSignup.description: Starts creating a merchant for an owner: Flint emails the owner a code that names your app, the business, the permissions and fee cap you request, and Flint's merchant terms. Show the owner Flint's terms checkbox in your form, collect the code, and send both to verify. Flint checks, in order and before any email: the partner app is yours and active (404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND at partner_app_id, or 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason unsupported_state for a deleted app); every requested_permission_ids value is in the manifest (400 INVALID_VALUE at that item); the app has a merchant_action_url, and its name and permission titles hold no link (409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason configuration_required); the app's live create_merchants capability; then the quotas. Until create_merchants is active, modes including live are refused with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED, capability create_merchants, param modes and the capability's inactive reason, and an owner outside your merchant's team is refused the same way with param owner.email. Quotas: 20 signups per app per UTC day before create_merchants is active and 1,000 after (409 LIMIT_REACHED with reason merchant_signups, limit and resets_at); 3 codes per owner mailbox per 15 minutes across every app (429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED with Retry-After) and 10 per 24 hours (409 LIMIT_REACHED with reason verification_codes). Plus-addresses count as their mailbox. The response never says whether the email already has a Flint login. Live only: test credentials get 403 FORBIDDEN with reason live_mode_required, and a key linked to a partner app install gets 403 FORBIDDEN with reason linked_key_not_allowed. Partner app tokens can't call it.

createMeReturn.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Requests a Return for one of the buyer's orders. An active return policy must cover each line and leave the requested quantity eligible, or the request fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `not_offered`. Check can_buyer_request with POST /v1/me/return-previews first. The buyer's reason must be active and apply to the line, and a policy that sends the request to review leaves the Return waiting for the store's decision. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

createMeReturnPreview.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Preview return eligibility or resolution amounts without creating a Return or reserving quantity. Set mode to eligibility or resolution and send the matching input object.

createMeSubscriptionPaymentRetry.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Starts one manual collection attempt on a past-due subscription. Send no body, or an empty object. Poll the returned retry for the outcome. While cancellation is scheduled, a new buyer retry fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `cancellation_scheduled`, with `current_status` `past_due`. First use PATCH /v1/me/subscriptions/{subscription_id} with cancel_at_period_end false to keep the subscription; retry_payment becomes available again if the other retry conditions allow it. Only one retry may be in progress at a time. Buyers can start a retry while fewer than 3 retries have been created for the current billing period, counting the store's retries too. subscription_card_update email-link sessions can start retries. When the store cannot accept payments, a new payment fails with 409 MERCHANT_NOT_READY and reason processing_restricted. Changes billed at a future renewal remain available. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

createMeSubscriptionPreview.description: Estimates a buyer's next subscription renewal, an offered plan change, or a quantity change, or lists delivery methods and rates for a proposed destination, without changing the subscription. plan_change uses the selected plan_change_options entry's billing_starts and the same checks and pricing as change-plan, including unused paid item credit when billing starts now or prorated_now. quantity_change accepts the change-quantity inputs with billing_starts prorated_now and returns the charge change-quantity would collect now, with the same refusals: only adjustable lines within min_quantity and max_quantity, and only eligible digital lines. next_renewal includes recurring promotions, shipping, and tax for the next charged cycle. Tax is null when tax can't be calculated yet; a tax service failure returns 502 EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR. Requires a full buyer session. A preview does not reserve inventory or guarantee a future shipping rate.

createModifierGroup.description: Creates a modifier group, a set of choices that customize an item, such as toppings or a custom message. Send `name`. A list group offers the choices in `modifiers`, with limits on how many buyers select; a text group takes a text entry instead, and sending `text` makes the group a text group. Attach groups to products, variants, and bundles through a modifier set. Defaults must stay within the group's selection limits.

createModifierSet.description: Creates a modifier set, a reusable collection of modifier groups that you attach to products, variants, and bundles by `modifier_set_id`. Send `name` and the ordered `modifier_groups`, each referencing a reusable group or defining a group owned by the set.

createOnboardingAccessLink.description: Creates a link into Flint-hosted onboarding for the authenticated merchant environment, for products that don't embed Connect.js. The page opens Account Onboarding and Notification Banner in the credential's mode, names the business, and for a partner app install token names the app. The link opens once, within 5 minutes, into a browser session of at most an hour, and every refresh of the page rechecks the credential that created it: revoking the API key, CLI login, or install, or authorizing the app again, ends the page. When the person exits or finishes, or opens a used or expired link, the page offers one action: back to return_url. The url is a bearer credential that lets whoever opens it enter identity and bank details for the merchant. Create it only for a person you just authenticated and authorized for this merchant, redirect them to it at once, and never email or log it. Takes the credentials of POST /v1/merchant-account-sessions. A partner app install token works in live mode only while its app's merchant_onboarding platform capability is active; otherwise it gets 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with the reason its platform status gives: platform_onboarding_required, platform_pending_review, platform_rejected, or platform_capability_inactive. A same-key, same-input retry replays the original link for 24 hours without extending its lifetime or replenishing its open. Use a new key for a new link.

createOrder.description: Creates an order for the authenticated merchant. For USD orders, an effective requested tip may be up to the larger of $1,000 or 100% of the post-discount merchandise subtotal.

createOrderAccessLink.description: Creates the link Flint's receipt email carries, to put in buyer email or messages you send yourself. It opens the order in your Flint-hosted customer account without a sign-in, and lets the buyer have the receipt sent again to the order's email. It works for 30 days or 10 opens, whichever comes first; after that the buyer signs in to see the order. The url is a bearer credential. Flint returns it only in this response and in a retry with the same idempotency key, so send it only to the buyer and keep it out of logs. A call with a new key creates another link; earlier links keep working until they expire. When customer_account.mode is merchant_hosted it fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `merchant_hosted_customer_accounts`, and for an order without a customer, with reason `configuration_required`. Dashboard sessions may create links when the staff member can view orders. Send no request body or an empty object ({}). Idempotency is scoped to the merchant, credential, environment, and this resource's route. A replay returns the original link without extending its lifetime or replenishing its opens. Without an idempotency key, each call creates a new link and has no replay result. If Flint cannot retain a result after minting, contact support with the request ID before sending a new request.

createOrderCharge.description: Adds a service charge, fee, or surcharge to an order.

createOrderEdit.description: Removes unassigned units from a paid order, adds items the removed value and released charges pay for, or does both, and queues any remaining refund atomically. Removed value and released charges pay for added lines first; only the remainder is refunded. Added lines are priced and taxed as usual, without promotions, and must be variant, bundle, or custom lines with a delivery requirement. They do not join the order's delivery selection. An edit that would leave a balance due writes nothing and returns LIMIT_EXCEEDED with reason order_edit_balance_due, with maximum_money equal to the removed value plus released charges. Bundle components must all be unassigned; dispatched quantities use Returns. Original quantities and pricing remain the sale record. The edit, added stock commitments, committed tax, and release of removed stock commit together; refund processing can continue afterward. Invoice-collected, subscription-owned, return-owned, disputed orders and unresolved inventory exceptions cannot be edited. Charges change only through charge_refunds. A zero-value edit creates no refund. Refund processing may still be pending, so refunds can be empty and refund.created follows later. Refund failures leave this immutable edit recorded. When supported_actions contains retry, use POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/edits/{order_edit_id}/retry to refund the remaining money. On VERSION_CONFLICT, keep the draft, fetch the order, preview again, and reconcile it before committing with the new expected_order_version and a new key. Retry a lost response with the original Idempotency-Key and unchanged body: Flint recovers the committed edit and its current order and refunds, without repeating the edit. If recovery cannot complete, retain the key and request ID for support; do not change keys to retry an uncertain result.

createOrderEditPreview.description: Calculates removing items from a paid order, adding items to it, or both, without changing it. Only whole unassigned units are removable; bundle components must all be unassigned. Original line quantity and pricing stay unchanged. Each removed unit's value includes its share of discounts and tax. Charges are released only when you list them in charge_refunds. Added lines use the line item create shape, are priced and taxed as usual without promotions, and must be lines Flint can fulfill: variant, bundle, and custom lines with a delivery requirement. The removed value and released charges pay for added lines first, removals in request order and then charges; the rest is refund_money, and what the added lines cost beyond that is amount_due_money. Invoice-collected, subscription-owned, return-owned, and disputed orders, and orders with an unresolved inventory exception, cannot be edited. Refund a line without fulfillment quantities, such as a digital item or service, with POST /v1/refunds. This calculation holds no stock and sets aside no refundable amount.

createOrderLineItems.description: Adds one or more line items to an order.

createOrderPaymentIntent.description: Creates a payment intent owned by the order. For online payments, collect a source using payment_collection, then submit it through payOrder. With payment_options [card_present], no payment_collection is returned; send a reader credential through payOrder. This route requires commerce.orders.write; standalone payment-intent routes require payments.payment_intents.write.

createPackage.description: Creates a package record under a shipment. Change package status through its lifecycle action routes, such as POST /v1/packages/{package_id}/mark-shipped; this endpoint records package-level carrier, tracking, label, measurement, and external correlation fields. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

createPackageItem.description: Adds an order line quantity to a package. Total active package item quantities cannot exceed the parent fulfillment line-item quantity.

createPartnerApp.description: Creates a partner app owned by the authenticated merchant. A live API key or a live dashboard session is required.

createPartnerAppCredential.description: Registers an immutable public key, JWKS URL, or workload identity for client assertion authentication. An app can have at most 20 active credentials. Dashboard callers need fresh identity verification. Replace a credential by creating a new one, then removing the old one.

createPaymentIntent.description: Creates a standalone payment intent for the authenticated merchant and returns it flat in data with payment_collection guidance for online payments. Create order-owned payment intents with POST /v1/orders/{order_id}/payment-intents.

createPaymentLink.description: Creates a payment link for the authenticated merchant. Line items may use fixed prices, buyer-adjustable amounts, and buyer-adjustable quantities.

createPaymentMethod.description: Initiates saving a payment method and returns the client setup payload needed to complete setup on the frontend.

createPaymentMethodDomain.description: Registers one exact domain or subdomain for Apple Pay and Google Pay in the selected Flint environment, then validates its wallet readiness.

createPayout.description: Creates a payout from an available balance to an eligible payout destination. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key.

createPriceList.description: Creates a merchant-only price list. Currency is immutable. A customer segment can belong to only one unarchived list, including inactive lists.

createPriceListPrices.description: Atomically adds 1 to 500 variant prices. on_variant_conflict defaults to return_existing; update replaces an existing price and its full schedule. Each addition reports created, existing, or updated. Returns 201 if any price was created, otherwise 200. One changed batch advances the list version once. A list holds up to 10,000 prices.

createProduct.description: Creates a product, the catalog item buyers purchase through orders, checkout, payment links, and subscriptions. Send `name`, `product_type`, and `variant_mode`. A `simple` product takes one `default_variant`; an `optioned` product takes `options` and `variants`, each variant selecting one value for every option. Price, SKU, and inventory settings live on variants.
