A SKU or barcode that another variant or bundle already uses fails with `ALREADY_EXISTS`, and a category handle that doesn't exist fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.

createProductVariant.description: Adds a variant to a product that has options. The variant selects one value for every option. Two variants can't select the same combination, and a SKU or barcode that another variant or bundle already uses is refused; both fail with `ALREADY_EXISTS`. A product without active options fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `configuration_required`: change a simple product through its default variant instead. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `archived` when the resource, or the parent it belongs to, is archived. The error names the archived resource and its `current_status`.

createPromotion.description: Creates a promotion: a discount that applies to qualifying orders automatically or when the buyer enters a promotion code. Send `name` and `application_method`; `redemption_type` chooses between automatic and code-gated, and a code-gated promotion can create up to 100 `codes` with it. Eligibility rules, a schedule, a redemption limit, and exclusivity are optional. The promotion is active unless you send `status: inactive`. A code that another resource already uses fails with `ALREADY_EXISTS`.

createPromotionCode.description: Creates a code for a promotion whose `redemption_type` is code; adding a code to an automatic promotion fails with `INVALID_REQUEST`. A code that another resource already uses fails with `ALREADY_EXISTS`. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `archived` when the resource, or the parent it belongs to, is archived. The error names the archived resource and its `current_status`.

createReader.description: Readers are payment hardware at a location: a Stripe Reader S710 or S700 your server sends payments to through Flint (`smart_reader`), or a phone that takes Tap to Pay in your app with the Stripe Terminal SDK (`tap_to_pay`). A reader is separate from a device, which records the register or phone that runs your app. Registers a smart reader with its pairing code, or a Tap to Pay reader for a phone, at a location with a complete US address. A pairing code works once, so send an `Idempotency-Key`: a retry with the same key returns the same reader. Registering needs no live payment readiness; payments on the reader do. Sends `reader.created`.

createReaderConnectionSession.description: Tap to Pay readers only. Creates a fresh single-use Stripe Terminal connection token for the reader's location: return `client_session.stripe.connection_token` from the SDK's `fetchConnectionToken` callback, and pass `client_session.stripe.location_id` to `TapToPayConnectionConfiguration`. Each call creates a new token, including a retry with the same `Idempotency-Key`. The token works with readers at the reader's location, not only this phone, so your server decides which phone gets which session. Keep your credential on your server.

createRefund.description: Creates a refund for an issued credit note on a paid invoice, an order, a payment intent, a captured gift card redemption, or a gift card load. Set refund_type to credit_note with credit_note_id to refund credit; omit amount_money to refund all available credit, resolved when Flint accepts the request. Credit-note refunds return card and bank payments collected through Flint, largest remaining first; gift card value is not refunded through credit notes yet. Set refund_type to full for the full remaining refundable amount, amount for an explicit amount_money, or targets for named line items, charges, and taxes. To refund a gift card redemption made outside a Flint order, set refund_type to amount and send one tender_allocations entry per redemption, with no order_id. A created refund is returned even when processing fails; inspect `status` and `failure_reason`. A same-key replay returns the original refund without another money attempt. This is a financial operation.

createReport.description: Creates an idempotent asynchronous CSV report. receivables_aging_v1 takes as_of_date instead of interval timestamps, with a cutoff at the earlier of the end of that local day and report creation. For interval reports, interval_end_at may be at most the same local time 366 calendar days after interval_start_at in timezone, and must not be in the future. Poll the returned report until it succeeds or fails.

createReturn.description: Create a requested Return. Every line needs the return_reason_id of an active reason. With an API key, a Return that no policy matches stays available for merchant review rather than failing creation.

createReturnAccessLink.description: Creates the link Flint's email about a Return carries, to put in buyer email or messages you send yourself. It opens the Return and its order in your Flint-hosted customer account without a sign-in. Withdrawing the Return needs the buyer to sign in. It works for 30 days or 10 opens, whichever comes first; after that the buyer signs in to see the Return. The url is a bearer credential. Flint returns it only in this response and in a retry with the same idempotency key, so send it only to the buyer and keep it out of logs. A call with a new key creates another link; earlier links keep working until they expire. When customer_account.mode is merchant_hosted it fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `merchant_hosted_customer_accounts`, and for a Return whose order has no customer, with reason `configuration_required`. Send no request body or an empty object ({}). Idempotency is scoped to the merchant, credential, environment, and this resource's route. A replay returns the original link without extending its lifetime or replenishing its opens. Without an idempotency key, each call creates a new link and has no replay result. If Flint cannot retain a result after minting, contact support with the request ID before sending a new request.

createReturnDisposition.description: Record an auditable merchandise disposition from either a receipt line or an inspection line. Read dispositions with `GET /v1/return-dispositions?return_id=` or expand `return_dispositions` on `GET /v1/returns/{return_id}`.

createReturnInspection.description: Record an immutable inspection observation. Corrections supersede an earlier inspection instead of editing physical history. Read inspections with `GET /v1/return-inspections?return_id=` or expand `return_inspections` on `GET /v1/returns/{return_id}`.

createReturnLineItem.description: Add a line item to a requested Return. The response is the updated Return, not the new line.

createReturnPolicy.description: Create a Return policy with its first revision. The policy ID is stable across revisions, and each published revision is immutable.

createReturnPolicyRevision.description: Publish a new immutable Return policy revision while preserving the stable policy identity. Send the policy's current version as expected_version to reject a concurrent policy edit or publish.

createReturnPreview.description: Preview return eligibility or resolution amounts without creating a Return or reserving quantity. Set mode to eligibility or resolution and send the matching input object.

createReturnReason.description: Create a merchant Return reason buyers can select. Buyer reasons are distinct from inspection findings, decline reasons, and Refund reasons. Flint handles and all existing merchant handles, including archived reasons, are reserved. A conflicting handle fails with `ALREADY_EXISTS`.

createReturnReceipt.description: Record an immutable merchandise receipt observation. Corrections supersede an earlier receipt instead of editing physical history. Read receipts with `GET /v1/return-receipts?return_id=` or expand `return_receipts` on `GET /v1/returns/{return_id}`.

createReturnResolution.description: Propose a buyer-value outcome for approved quantity. Creating a resolution reserves line value. Confirmation is what freezes it and starts its effects. Read resolutions with `GET /v1/return-resolutions?return_id=` or expand `return_resolutions` on `GET /v1/returns/{return_id}`.

createRiskList.description: Creates an empty list. Rules refer to it by alias, which can't be changed or reused, even after the list is archived. item_type decides how values are validated and compared.

createRiskListItems.description: Adds up to 500 values, each validated and normalized for the list's item_type. The additions array reports each value's outcome: values already on the list come back as existing, so a batch is safe to resend. The response is `201` when at least one value was added and `200` when none were. Payments see the change from the next attempt.

createRiskPreview.description: Validates a rule without saving anything. Send mode inline with action and predicate to check a draft; add risk_rule_id to check them as an edit to that rule. Send mode stored_rule with risk_rule_id, to check the saved rule, optionally overriding action or predicate. An omitted or null override keeps the saved value. Requires risk.read. Rule content issues produce a preview with `is_valid: false`, every issue in order, `analysis` null, and empty `warnings`. A valid rule returns analysis and any warnings about how the change would affect evaluation. List reference issues are reported at the list_alias path. A new rule at the active-rule limit gets a risk_rule_limit_reached warning. A malformed request fails with `INVALID_REQUEST`, and an unknown `risk_rule_id` fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. Proposing a different action or predicate for a Flint default rule fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `managed_externally`.

createRiskRule.description: Creates a rule that applies from the next payment attempt. Flint validates the predicate and checks every list before activating the rule. The rule is active unless you send status: inactive. An environment can have 100 active rules, counting Flint's defaults. To check a draft without saving it, use POST /v1/risk-previews.

createSandbox.description: Creates a new empty test sandbox for the current merchant. Send `issue_test_key: true` to also receive a test key bound to it; this also requires `accounts.api_keys.write`.

createShipment.description: Creates an outbound shipment for fulfillment_id or a return shipment for return_id. For outbound shipments, include 1 to 20 packages to create the parcels atomically and return their IDs. Set each package's status to shipped to report handoff in the same call. Return shipments cannot include packages.

createSubscription.description: Creates a subscription for a customer outside checkout. Send `customer_id`, the `terms` (a subscription plan or subscription offers), and `billing_start`, which says whether billing begins now, on a later date, or continues a period the buyer already paid elsewhere. Renewals charge `payment_method_id`, or the customer's default payment method when you omit it. Free trials without an upfront charge and `imported` starts can begin without a card when the customer has no default payment method; other starts fail with `INVALID_REQUEST` naming `payment_method_id`. A setup fee or other creation-time charge requires a card; scheduled starts also require one. Bind a card before `payment_method_due_at`: a trial without one cancels at that boundary without an attempted charge, while an imported subscription follows its normal dunning schedule. Flint requests the card three days before the boundary, or when a shorter trial begins. A default payment method that can't be used fails the request on every start. The payment method must belong to the customer, be active, and allow charges without the buyer present. A plan that is not active fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED`. Subscriptions require a customer with an email address in both customer account modes; otherwise creation returns 409 CUSTOMER_EMAIL_REQUIRED. Optional promotions (up to five) freeze current terms and qualify against the projected order for first_cycle. Imports alone accept consumed_cycles to carry over the buyer's used allowance. Attaching counts one promotion use and, when sent by code, one code use.

createSubscriptionAccessLink.description: Creates a link to one subscription in your Flint-hosted customer account, to put in buyer email or messages you send yourself. Omit purpose or send subscription_view for read-only access without a sign-in. Send subscription_manage to also let the buyer cancel, pause, or undo a scheduled cancellation, subject to your store's policy and the subscription's state. subscription_manage requires commerce.subscriptions.write; subscription_view requires commerce.subscriptions.read. Neither purpose permits other subscription changes or access to another subscription. Both work for 14 days or 5 opens, whichever comes first; after that the buyer signs in. The url is a bearer credential. Flint returns it only in this response and in a retry with the same idempotency key, so send it only to the buyer and keep it out of logs. A call with a new key creates another link; earlier links keep working until they expire. Dashboard sessions may create view links when the staff member can view subscriptions; subscription_manage requires permission to manage subscriptions. When customer_account.mode is merchant_hosted it fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `merchant_hosted_customer_accounts`. Send no request body, an empty object ({}), or an optional purpose and return_url. Idempotency is scoped to the merchant, credential, environment, and this resource's route. A replay returns the original link without extending its lifetime or replenishing its opens. Without an idempotency key, each call creates a new link and has no replay result. If Flint cannot retain a result after minting, contact support with the request ID before sending a new request.

createSubscriptionDeliveryMigration.description: Each subscription is previewed before its delivery method changes. Progress and per-subscription failures remain available after completion.

createSubscriptionLineItem.description: Adds a catalog variant or bundle to future subscription renewals. Current prices and delivery eligibility are checked before the line is saved. Already-created orders keep their lines.

createSubscriptionOffer.description: Create subscription offer. Offer changes affect new signups only. Existing subscriptions keep their terms.

createSubscriptionPaymentRetry.description: Starts one manual collection attempt on a past-due subscription. Send no body, or an empty object. Poll the returned retry for the outcome.

createSubscriptionPlan.description: Creates a subscription plan: the recurring price and terms customers sign up to. Send `name`, `currency`, the billing interval, and at least one line item from your catalog. An active plan accepts new signups; an inactive plan refuses them with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` while existing subscriptions keep renewing. A free trial isn't allowed on a plan with lines that ship.

createSubscriptionPreview.description: Estimates the next renewal, a plan change, or a promotion attachment, or evaluates a proposed subscription, delivery destination, or delivery method update without saving changes. next_renewal returns current recurring promotions, shipping, and tax for the next charged cycle. plan_change uses the same checks and pricing as change-plan, including unused paid item credit for billing_starts now or prorated_now. quantity_change accepts the change-quantity inputs and previews the same prorated charge without changing the subscription. promotion_apply uses the same checks as applying a promotion and returns the proposed attachment and the renewal estimate for its first_cycle; its refusals return HTTP errors. Tax is null when tax can't be calculated yet; a tax service failure returns 502 EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR. Malformed JSON, unknown fields and request-level problems (a missing or unsupported mode, fields that belong to another mode) return 400. Create mode returns SubscriptionCreatePreview with first_charge, first_period_charge, and recurring estimates, all null when validation prevents pricing. first_charge is the first Flint collection, including any separate setup fee; recurring is the first normal full-period collection without setup fees. With prorate_first_period, the prorated first period is first_charge, or first_period_charge when a setup fee is collected first, and recurring is cycle 2 at the end of that period. is_valid means valid and priceable inputs, not payment readiness. Card validation matches creation, including cardless imports. In create mode, every problem with the proposed subscription is returned in errors with is_valid false, including CUSTOMER_EMAIL_REQUIRED when the customer has no email and promotion refusals under subscription.promotions. A create preview attaches no promotions and counts no uses. A preview does not reserve inventory or guarantee a future shipping rate.

createTaxCalculationCallback.description: Tax calculation callback configuration is scoped to the selected environment. Partner installation tokens are unsupported. Creates an inactive callback and immutable revision 1. signing_methods defaults to ["jwt"]. Verify the JWT with Flint's public JWKS, aud equal to tax_calculation_callback_id, and body_sha256 over the exact request bytes. HMAC secrets are returned only once when hmac is selected.

createTaxCalculationCallbackTestDelivery.description: Tax calculation callback configuration is scoped to the selected environment. Partner installation tokens are unsupported. Sends a signed synthetic tax_calculation request with test true and empty line_items and charges. The response must echo tax_calculation_evaluation_id and return empty line_item_calculations and charge_calculations. Runs for inactive and active callbacks without changing the circuit breaker.

createTaxRegistration.description: Saves one US state registration for a non-overlapping, inclusive date window. Start_date may be up to 365 days ahead; end_date is optional. Before the connection is active, saves locally as pending without creating a tax account. On an active connection, syncs the registration in this request. Acceptance of a registration effective today marks open calculated automatic-tax orders without an issued invoice incomplete, advancing their versions. Scheduled registrations do not invalidate calculations. A definitive rejection before a tax-account registration exists removes the pending registration and leaves working tax and orders unchanged. If a tax-account copy exists or may have been created, rejection cleanup marks those open orders incomplete and advances their versions. Successful cleanup leaves the connection active. An uncertain outcome keeps the registration pending and the connection active; retry with the same key to resume without duplicating the registration. If the key is lost, filter the list by state and match the submitted start_date, delete the pending registration and create again after deletion succeeds.

createTestClock.description: Sandbox only. Creates a test clock stopped at `frozen_at`, with status `ready`. Customers created on it, and their subscriptions, read its time instead of real time.

createWebhookDelivery.description: Creates a delivery for a retained event and an endpoint that currently subscribes to it, then attempts delivery now. A failed attempt starts the automatic retry schedule. Each event and endpoint pair can have only one delivery. Partner-source endpoints are global configuration. Changes to them or their events and deliveries require a live-mode credential or a Dashboard session, including test events and endpoints subscribed only to test installed-merchant events. Test credentials fail with `FORBIDDEN` and reason `live_mode_required`, including on idempotent replay.

createWebhookEndpoint.description: Creates a webhook endpoint. signing_methods defaults to ["jwt"]. A shared secret is issued and returned once only when hmac is included. Partner-source endpoints are global configuration. Changes to them or their events and deliveries require a live-mode credential or a Dashboard session, including test events and endpoints subscribed only to test installed-merchant events. Test credentials fail with `FORBIDDEN` and reason `live_mode_required`, including on idempotent replay.

createWebhookTestEvent.description: Creates and delivers a synthetic test webhook event to one active webhook endpoint. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key. Partner-source endpoints are global configuration. Changes to them or their events and deliveries require a live-mode credential or a Dashboard session, including test events and endpoints subscribed only to test installed-merchant events. Test credentials fail with `FORBIDDEN` and reason `live_mode_required`, including on idempotent replay.

createWorkloadIdentity.description: Creates an active identity in the authenticated environment and validates issuer discovery. Dashboard callers creating live identities, or granting accounts.api_keys.write, accounts.workload_identities.write or commerce.gift_cards.secrets.write in any mode, need fresh identity verification. Other callers may grant only scopes they hold in this environment, and only a full-access key can grant those three.

decideReturn.description: Record one decision for every requested line atomically, then open the Return. To defer a line, decline its quantity or remove it with DELETE /v1/returns/{return_id}/line-items/{return_line_item_id} and open a separate Return for it. Omit completion_mode to use the shared pinned policy mode, or automatic when none sets a mode; disagreeing policies require an explicit completion_mode. completion_blockers reports uncovered approved quantity as resolution_not_selected alongside blockers for unfinished resolutions. Start from each buildable pinned policy proposal or the no-policy defaults, replace every supplied decision field, fill release_timing, and validate the result. When an automatic refund can no longer run through the original payment's provider, the request fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED`; send automatic_resolution_type as null to resolve manually, or choose no_monetary_action.

decideReturnInspectionLineItem.description: Record the accept or reject outcome for inspected quantity. expected_version compares against the inspection version. Accepted quantity becomes dispositionable and satisfies after_inspection release timing.

declinePaymentReview.description: Declines the payment and closes the review with `closed_reason: declined`. Flint cancels an uncaptured authorization, or refunds the remaining captured amount (captured minus earlier refunds) to the original payment method with reason `fraudulent`. The review is closed once the decline completes. If the refund already failed, the review is `open` again with `last_resolution_failure` set. While the refund is still processing, the decline is accepted but not complete; wait for `payment_review.closed` or `payment_review.reopened`.

deleteBundle.description: Archives a bundle and returns its final state. Returns the archived resource as a read does. Deleting an already archived resource returns it again without changing its version or `updated_at`, sending a webhook, or checking references. A stale `expected_version` fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT` and the `current_version`, even when the resource is already archived.

deleteCategory.description: Permanently deletes an unreferenced category and returns it with status deleted. Deleted categories cannot be retrieved or listed. Remove all product, bundle, promotion, and return configuration references before deleting.

deleteCustomDomain.description: Archives the hostname and starts its redirect retention window. Repeating the request returns the archived domain unchanged.

deleteCustomerAddress.description: Deletes a saved address. Deleting the billing or shipping default leaves the customer with none; Flint doesn't pick another address.

deleteCustomerTaxExemption.description: Archives the record and returns its archived snapshot in the same schema as GET. It stays readable by ID and is excluded from lists unless status includes archived. Expired and archived records cannot be edited. An optional expected_version query parameter rejects a stale write before effects. Retry a lost response with the same request and Idempotency-Key. If IDEMPOTENCY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED is returned, inspect this customer's list and GET records before sending a new write. Match a lost create against submitted fields across list pages; contact support with the original key and request ID if its outcome is unclear.

deleteDeliveryLocationSet.description: Retires the delivery location set. An active delivery method whose current revision still uses the location set as its origin blocks deletion: the request returns 409 RESOURCE_IN_USE with the blocking methods. Point those methods at another origin first. The retired resource remains available by ID for historical records. Deleting an already archived resource returns it without changing its version or repeating effects.

deleteDeliveryMethod.description: Retires the delivery method after checking current dependencies. The retired resource remains available by ID for historical records. Deleting an already archived resource returns it without changing its version or repeating effects. A method referenced by checkout.default_delivery_method_ids at merchant scope or by delivery_method_ids on an active or inactive payment link cannot be archived; the request returns 409 RESOURCE_IN_USE with the blocking references. Remove the method from checkout.default_delivery_method_ids with PATCH /v1/settings or from the link's delivery_method_ids with PATCH /v1/payment-links/{payment_link_id}. Open checkout sessions keep their pinned revision and do not block retirement.

deleteDeliveryProfile.description: Retires the delivery profile. Product variants, bundle components, or a catalog default that still use the profile block deletion: the request returns 409 RESOURCE_IN_USE with the blocking references. Assign those items to another delivery profile first. The retired resource remains available by ID for historical records. Deleting an already archived resource returns it without changing its version or repeating effects.

deleteDeliveryRateCallback.description: Retires the delivery rate callback. An active delivery method whose current revision still prices with the rate callback blocks deletion: the request returns 409 RESOURCE_IN_USE with the blocking methods. Move those methods to another pricing strategy first. The retired resource remains available by ID for historical records. Deleting an already archived resource returns it without changing its version or repeating effects.

deleteDeliveryZone.description: Retires the delivery zone. An active delivery method whose current revision still uses the zone blocks deletion: the request returns 409 RESOURCE_IN_USE with the blocking methods. Remove the zone from those methods first. The retired resource remains available by ID for historical records. Deleting an already archived resource returns it without changing its version or repeating effects.

deleteDevice.description: Archives a device and releases its hardware_fingerprint for reuse. The archived device no longer returns hardware_fingerprint. A device that an active reader names returns `409 RESOURCE_IN_USE` with those readers in `blocking_resources`: archive them or clear their `device_id` first.

deleteInventoryAllocationPolicy.description: Retire an allocation policy. The policy is archived: it stays readable by ID and appears in lists only when you filter by status archived.

deleteInventoryItem.description: Retire an inventory item. The item is archived: it stays readable by ID and appears in lists only when you filter by status archived.

deleteInvoicePaymentTerm.description: Retires an invoice payment term by setting its status to archived. A default payment term cannot be retired.

deleteLocation.description: Retire a Location. Preserves the archived resource for direct reads. Repeating DELETE returns the archived Location without changing its version or timestamps. An explicitly supplied expected_version must still match.

deleteMeAddress.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Deletes one of the buyer's saved addresses. Deleting the billing or shipping default leaves the customer with none; Flint doesn't pick another address. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

deleteMePaymentMethod.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Deletes a saved payment method so it can no longer be used for future payments. Returns the payment method with status archived, including when it was already archived. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

deleteModifierGroup.description: Archives a modifier group so buyers are no longer offered it, and returns its final state. A group that a modifier set which isn't archived still uses fails with `RESOURCE_IN_USE`; remove it from those sets, or archive them, first. Returns the archived resource as a read does. Deleting an already archived resource returns it again without changing its version or `updated_at`, sending a webhook, or checking references. A stale `expected_version` fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT` and the `current_version`, even when the resource is already archived.

deleteModifierSet.description: Archives a modifier set and returns its final state. A set that is still attached to a product, variant, or bundle fails with `RESOURCE_IN_USE`; set `modifier_set_id` to `null` on each of them first. Returns the archived resource as a read does. Deleting an already archived resource returns it again without changing its version or `updated_at`, sending a webhook, or checking references. A stale `expected_version` fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT` and the `current_version`, even when the resource is already archived.

deleteOrderCharge.description: Removes a single service charge, fee, or surcharge from an order.

deleteOrderLineItem.description: Removes a single line item from an order.

deletePackageItem.description: Removes an order line quantity from a package while the package is still mutable.

deletePartnerApp.description: Archives a partner app (soft delete). The app stays readable with status archived; it cannot be installed, exchange tokens, or receive events, and its client ID is never reused. Revoke every active install first; pending installs are revoked with the app. Delete the app’s webhook endpoints separately.

deletePartnerAppCredential.description: Soft-removes the credential and immediately stops its use for client authentication. The credential remains readable. Removing an already removed credential returns it unchanged.

deletePaymentMethod.description: Deletes a saved payment method so it can no longer be used for future payments. Returns the payment method with status archived, including when it was already archived.

deletePayoutDestination.description: Archives the payout destination and returns it with `status: archived`. It stays readable by ID. You can't delete the active default destination; make another destination the default with PATCH /v1/payout-settings first. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key.

deletePriceList.description: Soft-deletes a price list, releasing its segment assignments, and returns its full snapshot with status archived. A list referenced by customers returns RESOURCE_IN_USE. Repeating DELETE returns the same archived snapshot; a stale expected_version still returns VERSION_CONFLICT.

deletePriceListPrice.description: Permanently removes this variant price from its list and returns the parent price list with its new count and version. expected_version fences the parent price list. Repeating without the original Idempotency-Key returns RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.

deleteProduct.description: Archives a product and returns its final state. Returns the archived resource as a read does. Deleting an already archived resource returns it again without changing its version or `updated_at`, sending a webhook, or checking references. A stale `expected_version` fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT` and the `current_version`, even when the resource is already archived.

deleteProductVariant.description: Archives a variant and returns its final state. Returns the archived resource as a read does. Deleting an already archived resource returns it again without changing its version or `updated_at`, sending a webhook, or checking references. A stale `expected_version` fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT` and the `current_version`, even when the resource is already archived.

deletePromotion.description: Archives a promotion and returns it as a read does. Deleting an already archived promotion returns it again without changing its version or `updated_at`, sending a webhook, or checking references.

deletePromotionCode.description: Archives a promotion code. The code remains readable with status archived. Returns the archived resource as a read does. Deleting an already archived resource returns it again without changing its version or `updated_at`, sending a webhook, or checking references.

deleteReader.description: Archives a reader and returns it with `status: archived`. A smart reader is unregistered from Stripe shortly after, so its hardware can be paired again; a Tap to Pay reader stops getting connection sessions at once. Refused with `RESOURCE_IN_USE` while a payment is presented on the reader. Archiving an archived reader returns it unchanged. Sends `reader.archived`.

deleteReturnLineItem.description: Remove a line item from a requested Return. Send optional expected_version as one query parameter to fence against the parent Return version. The response is the updated Return.

deleteReturnPolicy.description: Archive a Return policy so it is no longer evaluated or offered. Archiving is permanent.

deleteReturnReason.description: Archive a Return reason so it can't be selected on new Return lines. Returns that recorded it keep its name and handle. Flint reasons can't be archived; set status to inactive instead. An archived reason's handle stays reserved.

deleteRiskList.description: Archives a list you created. Fails with `RESOURCE_IN_USE` while an active rule names it. Flint-managed lists fail with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `managed_externally`. Archived lists can't be used by rules or edited. Items can still be added to and removed from active Flint-managed lists.

deleteRiskListItem.description: Removes a value from a list permanently. Payments see the change from the next attempt.

deleteRiskRule.description: Archives a rule. It stops running at once and can't be changed or restored. Flint's default rules can't be archived; set them inactive instead.

deleteSandbox.description: Archives a non-default sandbox and frees its original name for reuse. A sandbox whose reset stopped after deletion started can be archived; its previous and new data are then deleted in the background.

deleteSubscriptionLineItem.description: Removes a line from future subscription renewals. The final line cannot be removed. Send expected_version as a query parameter to reject a concurrent change.

deleteSubscriptionOffer.description: Archive subscription offer. Offer changes affect new signups only. Existing subscriptions keep their terms.

deleteSubscriptionPlan.description: Permanently archives a subscription plan from active or inactive status. Returns RESOURCE_IN_USE while active subscriptions, active payment links, or open checkout sessions reference the plan. To stop selling a plan while keeping its subscribers, set status to inactive.

deleteTaxCalculationCallback.description: Tax calculation callback configuration is scoped to the selected environment. Partner installation tokens are unsupported. Archives the callback. Select another callback or clear tax.calculation_callback_id before archiving the selected callback.

deleteTaxRegistration.description: Hard-deletes a pending, rejected or scheduled registration and returns its final snapshot with status removed. While disconnected, deletes locally and records tax-account cleanup for the next connect. Otherwise, removes a possible tax-account copy first. If earlier creation is unconfirmed, an empty tax-account registration list does not prove the copy is absent: EXTERNAL_SERVICE_ERROR keeps the local registration. Retry the same request with the same idempotency key until the copy can be identified and removed. Provider failure retains the local registration. An online deletion of a pending or rejected registration that removes existing or possibly created tax-account coverage marks open calculated automatic-tax orders without an issued invoice incomplete and advances their versions. Scheduled and disconnected deletions do not invalidate calculations. Scheduled deletion removes its tax-account copy immediately unless disconnected, without pausing automatic tax or invalidating calculations. Active and ended registrations cannot be deleted. A later GET fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.

deleteTestClock.description: Sandbox only. Archives the test clock. It stays readable by ID, never advances again, and no new customer can be created on it. Customers and subscriptions already on it are not changed: they keep the clock's `frozen_at` as their current time, so their subscriptions don't bill again. Cancel those subscriptions first if you want them canceled, or reset the sandbox to remove everything. Deleting an archived clock returns it unchanged.

deleteWebhookEndpoint.description: Permanently deletes the webhook endpoint and returns it with status deleted. Its pending deliveries are suppressed. The endpoint cannot be retrieved afterward, and its past deliveries keep its webhook_endpoint_id. Partner-source endpoints are global configuration. Changes to them or their events and deliveries require a live-mode credential or a Dashboard session, including test events and endpoints subscribed only to test installed-merchant events. Test credentials fail with `FORBIDDEN` and reason `live_mode_required`, including on idempotent replay.

deleteWorkloadIdentity.description: Soft-archives the identity and returns it with status archived. The identity remains readable by ID and cannot be reactivated. Repeating DELETE without a stale fence returns the archived identity without changing its version.

departInventoryTransfer.description: Takes stock off the origin location and puts it in transit. Call it only when depart is in supported_actions. Lines carry cumulative targets, not deltas. Returns a result with inventory_transfer as its primary resource and inventory_levels for the levels changed. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory transfer by ID.

disconnectTaxConnection.description: Turns automatic tax off while retaining the tax account and registrations for reconnecting. Choose tax_default_behavior explicitly: turn_off stops adding tax to new orders, checkout sessions and renewals that inherit the default; keep leaves the default unchanged, refuses those orders and holds renewals for retry without charging buyers or starting dunning. Payment links that explicitly enable automatic tax are refused when creating a checkout session with either choice. Settings are updated first when needed, then the connection is disconnected and open calculated automatic-tax orders without an issued invoice snapshot become incomplete. Issued invoice snapshots are unchanged. A same-key retry resumes after settings were changed; after a lost response, retrieve the connection and disconnect again if needed.

dispatchFulfillment.description: Records that a shipment or local delivery fulfillment has left for its destination. Read supported_actions for actions available now. occurred_at records when the action occurred; on complete it also records completion evidence. expected_version optionally rejects a stale fulfillment version. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

exchangeOAuthToken.description:
Partner apps authenticate with client assertions, HTTP Basic, or client_secret_post. Assertions require client_id, client_assertion_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:client-assertion-type:jwt-bearer, and client_assertion; never mix them with a secret or HTTP Basic. Self-signed private_key_jwt assertions are verified against the app's public_key and jwks_url credentials. They require iss=sub=client_id, a single-string aud equal to the Flint issuer, exp no more than five minutes ahead, and a single-use jti, signed with ES256, ES384, PS256, RS256 (RSA keys of 2048 to 4096 bits and exponent 65537), or EdDSA. Workload identity assertions are tokens from the external issuer of a workload_identity credential: iss is that issuer, and Flint verifies them with the issuer's published keys. They must match the credential's subject, audience, and claim conditions, be signed with RS256, RS384, RS512, PS256, PS384, PS512, ES256, ES384, or ES512, and expire no more than one hour and 60 seconds ahead; Flint does not require a jti. Assertion replay storage outages, and JWKS URL or issuer outages that leave no usable keys, return 503 temporarily_unavailable. Partner apps get partner app tokens: opaque fpat_ Bearer tokens for one mode that last 900 seconds, with no refresh token. grant_type=client_credentials mints one with the app's client authentication; mode (test or live) is required, and merchant_id optionally binds the token to one merchant, checked for format only. scope is refused with invalid_scope, because each request uses the selected merchant's grant. Only server apps can mint, and a partner client that sends grant_type=refresh_token gets unauthorized_client. The response has access_token, token_type, expires_in, partner_app_id, mode, and merchant_id for a merchant-bound token. Each app can mint 600 tokens per minute after client authentication, beside the per-IP budget; over it returns HTTP 429 temporarily_unavailable with Retry-After and Flint-Rate-Limited-Reason: resource. Cache one token per mode and mint again when it expires. grant_type=authorization_code exchanges a 5-minute, single-use code with S256 PKCE, activates the install and environment grant, and returns a partner app token bound to the installing merchant and the grant's mode, with scope (the granted permission IDs), merchant_id, partner_app_install_id, environment_grant_id, mode, and sandbox_id in test mode. Reusing a code returns invalid_grant and revokes the token its first exchange minted; the grant stays. Deleting the credential that minted a token, disabling the client secret, rotating it with an immediate expiry, and archiving the app revoke the affected tokens. This endpoint follows OAuth token endpoint conventions: send application/x-www-form-urlencoded only. Failures return OAuth token error objects. Repeated Authorization fields return 400 INVALID_REQUEST with a NOT_ALLOWED detail at Authorization in the Flint error envelope before client authentication.

The public client flint-cli supports the RFC 8628 device_code grant and rotating refresh tokens. Pending device requests return authorization_pending; early polling returns slow_down and increases the required interval by five seconds; denial returns access_denied; expired or consumed codes return expired_token. CLI access tokens last 15 minutes. CLI sessions expire after 30 days idle or 90 days total. Reusing a rotated CLI refresh token revokes its family, including when the previous response was lost. A fresh browser login is then required.

With session_mode=contexts at CLI authorization, tokens include oauth_session_id and context_id. CLI refresh requires an explicitly authorized context_id; invalid_context and context_access_denied do not consume the refresh token. Each CLI access token is limited to one context. Ordinary CLI rotation preserves other unexpired access tokens; removing consent immediately invalidates affected tokens. CLI refresh scope may request a subset of the selected grant or context scopes. Only the issued access token is narrowed; consent and other tokens are unchanged. A later refresh without scope restores the full consented scopes. Legacy CLI sessions retain their original response shape. Request rate limits return HTTP 429 temporarily_unavailable with Retry-After and Flint-Rate-Limited-Reason. Device-code token polling returns HTTP 400 slow_down for both early polls and request rate limits.

Workload identities use grant_type=urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange with subject_token, subject_token_type, and workload_identity_id. subject_token_type must be urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:jwt or urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:id_token. Optional scope narrows the identity scopes for this token; requested_token_type, if supplied, must be urn:ietf:params:oauth:token-type:access_token. Client authentication, client_id, actor_token, resource, audience, and unrecognized fields are forbidden and return invalid_request. The response includes an opaque fwat_ access token, issued_token_type, workload_identity_id, merchant_id, mode, and sandbox_id in test mode, without a refresh token. The token expires after the shorter of one hour and the remaining subject-token lifetime. Identity deactivation, archive, and scope narrowing take effect on the next API request. Exchange errors use invalid_request, invalid_grant, invalid_scope, unsupported_grant_type, temporarily_unavailable, and server_error. Limits are 300 requests per minute per IP and 600 per minute per identity after signature verification; exceeding either returns HTTP 429 temporarily_unavailable with Retry-After and Flint-Rate-Limited-Reason. No usable external issuer keys returns HTTP 503 temporarily_unavailable.

failFulfillment.description: Records fulfillment failure and explicitly releases or preserves the allocated quantities. Read supported_actions for actions available now. occurred_at records when the action occurred; on complete it also records completion evidence. expected_version optionally rejects a stale fulfillment version. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

freezeGiftCard.description: Freezes spending on an active or frozen card with a merchant reason. Accepted payment reservations remain intact. expected_version fences the gift card version.

getAnalyticsOverview.description: Returns high-level merchant analytics for the requested half-open period.

getAPIKey.description: Returns external API key metadata. Secrets, internal keys, and demo-session keys are not returned.

getAPIRequestLog.description: Returns one request with redacted headers, the redacted request and response bodies for write routes that capture them, and a curl reproduction. Detail older than 14 days has no headers or bodies.

getAuthContext.description: Returns non-secret metadata for the credential that sent the request, as one object per credential type selected by auth_type. API keys, CLI logins, workload identities, partner apps, and onboarding sessions are accepted. No scope is required.

getBalanceTransaction.description: Returns one balance transaction by ID, with optional related order expansion.

getBundle.description: Returns one bundle by ID, with its price, components, and whether it is available for sale.

getCategory.description: Returns one category by ID, with its handle, name, and the counts of products and bundles assigned to it. A deleted category fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.

getCheckoutSession.description: Returns a single checkout session by ID.

getCheckoutSessionCustomerVerification.description: Only the session's own checkout credential can read its verification code requests. Only requests whose code hasn't expired are readable until expires_at; an expired, unknown, malformed, deleted, or other session's request returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND. Emails are masked on every read. A request reads the same whether or not a code was sent, confirmed, or replaced. Reads send nothing and change no code or attempt counters.

getCreditNote.description: Returns one credit note with its lines, total, and the credit still available to allocate.

getCreditNoteAllocation.description: Returns one allocation. A non-null reversed_at means the credit was returned to the credit note and the invoice balance reopened.

getCreditNotePDF.description: Returns the credit note document as application/pdf rather than a JSON envelope. The PDF exists from issue onward and shows the credited lines, totals, and the invoice it corrects. It uses your current branding, so a later download can differ in logo or colors, but not in content.

getCustomDomain.description: Returns a custom domain, including archived domains.

getCustomer.description: Returns a single customer by ID.

getCustomerAddress.description: Returns one saved address owned by the customer.

getCustomerDeletionRequest.description: Returns the current status of a tracked deletion request.

getCustomerEmailPreferences.description: Returns the preferences for the customer's current email address in this merchant environment. A missing choice is enabled. Reads remain available while deletion is processing. Returns RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND for an unknown or deleted customer, or with reason email_missing when the customer has no email address. Merchants cannot change these preferences.

getCustomerTaxExemption.description: Returns one exemption belonging to this customer, including an archived record. A record belonging to another customer returns RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND. Evidence references are merchant-only; customer and checkout sessions cannot access this route.

getCustomerVerification.description: Returns one customer verification in any status. Status and supported_actions are computed when read. Flint deletes a verification 8 days after its code and proof expire; customer deletion also removes it.

getDeliveryLocationSet.description: Returns the current revision and lifecycle state for one delivery location set.

getDeliveryMethod.description: Returns the current revision and lifecycle state for one delivery method.

getDeliveryProfile.description: Returns the current revision and lifecycle state for one delivery profile.

getDeliveryQuote.description: Returns a delivery quote by its ID. API keys receive the same merchant view as the quote list. A checkout credential reads only quotes of its own checkout session and receives the buyer view; any other quote is refused as not found.

getDeliveryRateCallback.description: Returns the current revision and lifecycle state for one delivery rate callback.

getDeliveryRevocation.description: Returns one permanent delivery revocation and its estimated impact at creation time.

getDeliverySelection.description: Returns one delivery selection, current or earlier, with its economics, lifecycle events, and retention-aware private data. While the selection is selected, the tax on its delivery charges follows the order's tax. A checkout credential reads only its own session's selections and receives the buyer view; any other selection is refused as not found.

getDeliveryZone.description: Returns the current revision and lifecycle state for one delivery zone.

getDevice.description: Returns a single device by ID.

getDispute.description: Returns one dispute by ID, with optional customer, order, and payment intent expansions.

getEffectiveSettings.description: Returns the authenticated merchant's settings for this environment with Flint's defaults filled in.

getFeedbackReport.description: Returns one immutable feedback report in the credential's merchant and environment.

getFile.description: Returns a file's current status without upload credentials. Purpose requires its own read scope: product and product_variant use commerce.products.read; bundle uses commerce.bundles.read; payment_link uses checkouts.payment_links.read; subscription_plan uses commerce.subscription_plans.read; merchant_logo and merchant_icon use merchants.profile.read. The matching write scope also grants read access. Dashboard sessions require the purpose's manage capability. Logo and icon files are merchant-wide; other files belong to the authenticated environment. Partner install tokens need the same purpose scope. Expired deadlines are reflected immediately. Only ready files include url, width, and height. The response uses Cache-Control: no-store.

getFraudWarning.description: Retrieves an early fraud warning. Expand `payment_intent` or `dispute` to include them.

getFulfillment.description: Retrieves a single fulfillment by ID.

getFulfillmentEvent.description: Retrieves one provider-neutral fulfillment event by ID.

getFulfillmentNotification.description: Retrieves one fulfillment notification audit record by ID.

getGiftCard.description: Retrieves the current gift card, including supported lifecycle actions and balance projections. A gift card ID does not authorize a buyer to spend it.

getGiftCardFundingDisposition.description: Retrieves a committed funding disposition within the authenticated merchant and environment.

getGiftCardLoad.description: Retrieves original value, consideration, funding provenance and remaining attributable value for one load.

getGiftCardNotification.description: Retrieves a notification and its sending outcome. Sent means the sending provider accepted the message; it does not mean the recipient read it.

getGiftCardRedemption.description: Retrieves requested, reserved, captured, refunded and remaining refundable value with the current reservation status.

getInventoryAdjustment.description: Retrieve an inventory adjustment and its lines by ID.

getInventoryAllocationPolicy.description: Retrieve an allocation policy by ID, including archived policies.

getInventoryAllocationPolicyRevision.description: Retrieve the immutable routing configuration captured by one allocation policy revision.

getInventoryCount.description: Retrieve an inventory count and its saved observations by ID.

getInventoryItem.description: Retrieve an inventory item by ID, including archived items.

getInventoryLevel.description: Retrieve an inventory level's current quantities and version by ID.

getInventoryMovement.description: Retrieve an inventory movement and its stock changes by ID.

getInventoryReceipt.description: Retrieve a completed inventory receipt and its disposition lines by ID.

getInventoryReservation.description: Retrieve an inventory reservation and its lines by ID, including merchant and order owners.

getInventoryTransfer.description: Retrieve an inventory transfer, its lines, and supported_actions by ID.

getInvoice.description: Returns a single invoice by ID.

getInvoiceManualPayment.description: Returns one recorded or reversed manual payment for the invoice.

getInvoicePaymentAttempt.description: Returns one card or ACH collection attempt for the invoice.

getInvoicePaymentTerm.description: Returns one invoice payment term for the authenticated merchant.

getInvoicePDF.description: Downloads the merchant-authenticated PDF artifact generated from the invoice snapshot.

getLocation.description: Returns one location by ID, with its address, timezone, status, and whether it accepts inventory allocation. Archived locations remain readable by ID.

getMe.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the buyer's customer profile.

getMeAddress.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's saved addresses.

getMeCreditNote.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one credit note with its lines, total, and the credit still available to allocate.

getMeCreditNotePDF.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the credit note document as application/pdf rather than a JSON envelope. The PDF exists from issue onward and shows the credited lines, totals, and the invoice it corrects. It uses your current branding, so a later download can differ in logo or colors, but not in content.

getMeDeletionRequest.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the status of one of the buyer's deletion requests.

getMeEmailPreferences.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Returns which of the merchant's optional email categories the customer's current email receives in the selected merchant environment. A category the buyer never changed is on. Email preferences exist only for a customer with an email: without one, the read fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`. Receipts and other transactional email always send.

getMeFulfillment.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's fulfillments.

getMeGiftCard.description: Requires a full customer session. Saved access requires possession of a current code or recipient link. Customer associations and purchase history do not authorize access. Replacing a code invalidates saved access; save again with fresh proof. Saved access does not permit spending or reveal a full code.

getMeInvoice.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's invoices. A draft invoice fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.

getMeInvoicePDF.description: Accepts a customer session, which limits the request to that customer's invoices, or the access token from this invoice's public link, which limits it to this invoice. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns the invoice document as application/pdf rather than a JSON envelope.

getMeOrder.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's orders.

getMeOrderReceiptPDF.description: Downloads a numbered receipt for an order with collected money, covering successful payment intents and gift card redemptions, including payments and refunds. Orders paid only by manual cash, check, or wire invoice payments return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason unsupported_state; download the invoice PDF instead. Mixed orders list only successful payment intents and gift card redemptions. Available under either order_receipts email delivery mode. Buyer and seller identity is frozen on the first snapshot write; payments, refunds, and branding are current.

getMePackage.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's packages.

getMePaymentIntent.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's payments.

getMePaymentMethod.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's saved payment methods.

getMerchantBillingBalance.description: Returns what the merchant currently owes Flint and owns as account credit in one currency.

getMerchantBillingInvoice.description: Returns one invoice issued by Flint for the authenticated merchant environment.

getMerchantSignup.description: Returns one of your partner apps' signups. A completed signup stays readable, including the owner's name and email, after the merchant disconnects the app. Live only: test credentials get 403 FORBIDDEN with reason live_mode_required, and a key linked to a partner app install gets 403 FORBIDDEN with reason linked_key_not_allowed. Partner app tokens can't call it.

getMeRefund.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's refunds.

getMeReturn.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's Returns.

getMeReturnResolution.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns a buyer-visible Return resolution, including the amount the buyer needs to pay. Use the checkout_session action to pay its balance.

getMeShipment.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's shipments.

getMeSubscription.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Returns one of the buyer's subscriptions. subscription_plan is always included without expand: the plan's current summary, or null when the subscription has no plan.

getMeSubscriptionPaymentRetry.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Returns one durable manual subscription payment retry.

getModifierGroup.description: Returns one modifier group by ID, with its choices, selection limits, and whether it appears on receipts and in fulfillment details.

getModifierSet.description: Returns one modifier set by ID, with its ordered modifier groups.

getOnboardingState.description: Returns the consolidated onboarding state machine, including the primary next step for agents or humans. This endpoint is read-only. The credential selects the environment; the onboarding session token acts in the merchant's default sandbox.

getOpenAPISpec.description: Returns the Flint public OpenAPI document for tooling, schema inspection, and client generation. The document describes one API version: the `version` query parameter if you send it, otherwise the `Flint-Version` header, otherwise Flint's current version. The route takes no credential. The body is gzip-compressed when the request's `Accept-Encoding` header accepts gzip.

getOrder.description: Returns a single order by ID.

getOrderEdit.description: Returns an immutable edit with its frozen refund amounts and current refund IDs. The internal note is visible to merchant callers only.

getOrderPaymentAttempt.description: Returns one durable payment attempt for the order. Checkout-session callers can read only attempts created by their own session.

getOrderReceiptPDF.description: Downloads a numbered receipt for an order with collected money, covering successful payment intents and gift card redemptions, including payments and refunds. Orders paid only by manual cash, check, or wire invoice payments return 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason unsupported_state; download the invoice PDF instead. Mixed orders list only successful payment intents and gift card redemptions. Available under either order_receipts email delivery mode. Buyer and seller identity is frozen on the first snapshot write; payments, refunds, and branding are current.

getPackageItem.description: Retrieves one package item by ID.

getPartnerApp.description: Returns a single partner app owned by the authenticated merchant. A live partner app token can read its own app, without Flint-Merchant-Id or Flint-Sandbox-Id; another app's ID returns 404 as an unknown ID does.

getPartnerAppCredential.description: Returns a credential, including a removed credential.

getPartnerAppInstall.description: Returns a single install for the installing merchant, the partner app owner, or a live partner app token for the app. A merchant-bound token reads only its merchant's install; other installs return 404. For the app’s owner and its tokens, each active grant that can read the merchant profile carries `merchant_readiness`, the installed merchant’s payments and payouts readiness in that environment.

getPaymentIntent.description: Returns a single payment intent by ID. Unverified fee fields are omitted; read the intent again later for verified fees. For a standalone payment intent in requires_action, call confirm with credential_type attached to retrieve current_payment_action.

getPaymentLink.description: Returns a single payment link by ID. With expand=sales_summary, includes gross paid totals and refunded totals per currency.

getPaymentLinkPublic.description: Returns the sanitized buyer-facing payment-link snapshot and a private resolution context for this browser operation.

getPaymentMethod.description: Returns a single payment method by ID.

getPaymentMethodDomain.description: Returns one environment-scoped payment method domain and its Apple Pay and Google Pay readiness.

getPaymentReview.description: Retrieves a payment review. Expand `payment_intent`, `order`, or `customer` to include them.

getPaymentSplit.description: Read splits you collected or received, with your own credentials and money_movement.payment_splits.read. Install tokens can't read splits. Test splits are in the collecting merchant's sandbox and the seller's test grant's sandbox. Consumers include marketplace payment pages and seller reconciliation.

getPaymentVolumeTimeseries.description: Returns merchant payment volume buckets for the requested half-open period.

getPayout.description: Returns one payout by ID, with optional related payout and payout destination expansions.

getPayoutDestination.description: Returns one payout destination by ID.

getPayoutSettings.description: Returns payout settings that control default payout behavior for the authenticated merchant.

getPlatformFee.description: Returns one platform fee. Reads the merchant that owns the partner app, with its own credentials and money_movement.platform_fees.read; partner app tokens can't. Live records are in your live environment. Test records are in your default sandbox at the time the payment was created. A merchant that owns no partner app gets an empty list.

getPlatformFeeBalanceTransaction.description: Returns one entry of your partner apps' platform fee ledger. Reads the merchant that owns the partner app, with its own credentials and money_movement.platform_fees.read; partner app tokens can't. Live records are in your live environment. Test records are in your default sandbox at the time the payment was created. A merchant that owns no partner app gets an empty list.

getPlatformFeePayout.description: Returns one platform fee payout. Reads the merchant that owns the partner app, with its own credentials and money_movement.platform_fees.read; partner app tokens can't. Live records are in your live environment. Test records are in your default sandbox at the time the payment was created. A merchant that owns no partner app gets an empty list.

getPriceList.description: Returns a price list by ID, including archived lists. Price lists and their segment assignments are merchant-only.

getPriceListPrice.description: Returns a variant price and its complete quantity schedule within this price list.

getProduct.description: Returns a single product by ID.

getProductOption.description: Returns one option of a product, such as size or color, with its values and position.

getProductVariant.description: Returns one variant of a product, including its price, SKU, selected options, inventory settings, and delivery configuration status.

getPromotion.description: Returns a single promotion by ID.

getPromotionCode.description: Returns a single promotion code by code ID. Archived codes remain readable, including codes of an archived promotion. Fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` when the code does not exist or belongs to another merchant or environment.

getReader.description: Returns a reader, including an archived one, with the payment presented on it now in `active_payment_intent_id`.

getRefund.description: Returns a single refund by ID.

getReport.description: Returns one report and its terminal download or failure details when available.

getReportDownload.description: Authorizes the stable Flint download URL and redirects to a short-lived private file URL.

getResourceTimeline.description: Returns summary-only API request, webhook event, webhook delivery attempt, and image mutation entries for a single public API resource. The caller must have developer.resource_timelines.read and the matching read scope for the requested resource type. Default order: occurred_at descending, then resource_timeline_entry_id descending.

getReturn.description: Retrieve a Return with its line items, policy evaluation, financial summary, and completion blockers. Supports expand for the order, customer, receipts, inspections, dispositions, resolutions, shipments, and each line item's reason and fulfillment.

getReturnDisposition.description: Retrieve one disposition with its type, destination, quantity, status, and any linked inventory effect.

getReturnInspection.description: Retrieve one inspection with its line items, findings, and current or superseded observation status.

getReturnLineItem.description: Retrieve one Return line item, including its quantity counters and the reason the buyer selected.

getReturnPolicy.description: Retrieve one Return policy. Supports expand for current_revision.

getReturnPolicyRevision.description: Retrieve one immutable policy revision, including the exact rules a Return was evaluated against.

getReturnReason.description: Retrieve one Return reason with its handle, category handles, and status.

getReturnReceipt.description: Retrieve one merchandise receipt with its line items and its current or superseded observation status.

getReturnResolution.description: Retrieve one resolution with its amounts, adjustments, execution blockers, and linked refunds, payments, and replacement order. Supports expand for those links.

getRiskList.description: Retrieves a risk list. item_count is its current number of values.

getRiskListItem.description: Retrieves one value on a list.

getRiskRule.description: Retrieves a risk rule. The issues array lists anything that stops Flint from evaluating it.

getRiskRuleAttributes.description: Lists the attributes a predicate can read in this environment, with each one's value type, operators, and the stage it becomes available. An attribute with is_available: false can't be used yet. Payment intent metadata is also readable as payment_intent_metadata.{key}, which isn't listed.

getSandbox.description: Returns a single sandbox by ID. A test credential (API key, CLI login, or workload token) can read only the sandbox it is bound to; any other `sandbox_id` gets 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.

getSettings.description: Returns the settings stored for the authenticated merchant in this environment.

getShipment.description: Retrieves one shipment execution record by ID.

getSubscription.description: Returns a single subscription by ID. A paid checkout session's credential can retrieve only the subscription created by its source order. Checkout credentials cannot expand related resources.

getSubscriptionAnalytics.description: Returns windowed subscription metrics plus current subscription snapshot metrics.

getSubscriptionDeliveryMigration.description: Each subscription is previewed before its delivery method changes. Progress and per-subscription failures remain available after completion.

getSubscriptionOffer.description: Get subscription offer. Offer changes affect new signups only. Existing subscriptions keep their terms.

getSubscriptionPaymentRetry.description: Returns one durable manual subscription payment retry.

getSubscriptionPlan.description: Returns a single subscription plan by ID.

getTaxCalculationCallback.description: Tax calculation callback configuration is scoped to the selected environment. Partner installation tokens are unsupported.

getTaxConnection.description: Returns the environment's automatic sales tax connection, including before a record exists. Read the disclosure and status_reason to learn what connect needs. Business-detail changes, temporary provider pauses and registration date boundaries are computed at read time and do not advance version or send webhooks.

getTaxRegistration.description: Returns one saved tax registration. Removed registrations return RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.

getTestClock.description: Sandbox only. Returns a test clock in this sandbox, including an archived one.

getTicket.description: Returns an individual ticket. Merchant credentials never receive its admission code. The checkout credential of a paid checkout session reads only its own order's tickets, without expand, and receives admission_code unless the ticket is voided or the credential came from a launch URL a merchant read or requested after payment; another order's ticket returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.

getWebhookDelivery.description: Returns one endpoint delivery and its current retry state. Global partner-source records are invisible in sandbox mode; a direct reference returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.

getWebhookEndpoint.description: Returns a single webhook endpoint by ID. The signing secret is omitted after creation. Global partner-source records are invisible in sandbox mode; a direct reference returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.

getWebhookEvent.description: Returns a specific webhook event for the authenticated merchant. Global partner-source records are invisible in sandbox mode; a direct reference returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND.

getWorkloadIdentity.description: Returns an identity in the authenticated environment, including an archived identity.

holdFulfillment.description: Pauses fulfillment work with a required merchant hold reason. Read supported_actions for actions available now. occurred_at records when the action occurred; on complete it also records completion evidence. expected_version optionally rejects a stale fulfillment version. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

issueCreditNote.description: Issues a draft credit note and freezes its number, lines, and totals. Provide allocation to issue and apply credit to its invoice atomically, or refund to initiate a linked refund on a paid invoice. Allocation and refund cannot be combined. Omit allocation.amount_money to apply the smaller of the credit available after issue and the invoice's outstanding balance. An explicit amount must be positive, use the invoice's currency, and fit both balances. The result includes credit_note_allocation when allocation is requested. Idempotency-Key is required and is retained for as long as the issue's effects exist, scoped to merchant, environment, credit note, and key. Reuse the key with the identical request to recover the original credit note and allocation. After a lost response, list this note's allocations or refunds filtered by the issue request's idempotency_key. A pending refund is accepted but has not completed. Without allocation or refund, issuance leaves the invoice balance unchanged. Issue validates the stored preview against current shared creditable pools. A fitting correction whose preview changed fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT`, which includes the credit note and `current_version`: replace its existing corrections with PATCH using the current expected_version, review the recalculated amounts, and issue again. A stored correction exceeding the remaining pool fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `not_offered`. Update the draft lines before issuing again. Affected historical tax allocations fail with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `credit_note_tax_reconciliation_required`.

issueInvoice.description: Issues the invoice, creates the buyer-access link, and uses the selected delivery mode. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key.

linkCustomerGuestPurchases.description: Links purchases with the verified email and no customer to the verification's customer in the same merchant environment. Purchases bound to another customer stay with that customer. The verification is single use; use the same idempotency key to retry an uncertain result.

listAPIKeys.description: Returns merchant-bound external API key metadata. Internal keys, demo-session keys, and secrets are never returned. Default order: created_at descending, then api_key_id descending.

listAPIRequestLogs.description: Returns request summaries, newest first. With developer.request_logs.read the list covers every caller in the credential's environment. With developer.request_logs.self.read it covers only the calling credential's requests. With partner_app_id naming a partner app your merchant owns, the list instead covers that app's partner app token requests in every merchant that installed it, in the credential's mode; the detail route still reads only the credential's environment. Headers, bodies and a reproduction are on the detail route. Default order: created_at descending, then api_request_log_id descending.

listBalances.description: Returns the current balance snapshot grouped by currency for the authenticated merchant in the standard list envelope. All balances fit on one page, so next_page_token is omitted. Default order: currency ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.

listBalanceTransactions.description: Returns a paginated ledger of balance-affecting transactions, including availability timing and related public resources. Default order: occurred_at descending, then balance_transaction_id descending.

listBundleComponents.description: List bundle components. Default order: position ascending, then bundle_component_id ascending.

listBundles.description: List bundles. Default order: created_at descending, then bundle_id descending.

listCategories.description: List categories. Default order: handle ascending; this key uniquely orders the results.

listCheckoutSessionCustomerVerifications.description: Only the session's own checkout credential can read its verification code requests. Only requests whose code hasn't expired are readable until expires_at; an expired, unknown, malformed, deleted, or other session's request returns 404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND. Emails are masked on every read. A request reads the same whether or not a code was sent, confirmed, or replaced. Reads send nothing and change no code or attempt counters. Returns requests newest first by created_at descending, then checkout_session_customer_verification_id descending. Default order: created_at descending, then checkout_session_customer_verification_id descending.

listCheckoutSessions.description: Returns a paginated list of checkout sessions for the authenticated merchant. Default order: created_at descending, then checkout_session_id descending.
