Signing fails closed if the shared quota store is unavailable. Responses are not cached or retained for idempotency. Previously issued JWTs remain usable until expiry after endpoint changes.

simulateDispute.description: Sandbox only. Simulates the card network's ruling on a dispute that needs a response. Flint submits Stripe's test evidence for the `outcome`, and the ruling arrives through the dispute's usual webhook events, as a real one would. Send `won` or `lost` for a chargeback in `needs_response`, and `inquiry_closed` or `escalated` for an inquiry in `inquiry_needs_response`. The response is the dispute after the evidence is submitted, usually `under_review` or `inquiry_under_review`. Stripe decides shortly after, with no fixed timing. Requires `payments.disputes.write`. If you don't receive a response, retry with the same idempotency key, or read the dispute.

simulateReader.description: Sandbox only. Presents a Stripe test card on a simulated reader (registered with `registration_code: simulated-s700`) for the payment presented on it, so the result arrives the way a real tap's does. Returns the reader. A live credential gets `403 FORBIDDEN` with reason `test_mode_required`.

skipMeSubscriptionCycle.description: While prepaid deliveries remain, defers the next delivery and next charge by one delivery interval without consuming a delivery. Otherwise skips the next renewal without charging or shipping and moves the next billing date forward by one billing interval while preserving billing_anchor_day, including in shorter months. Available when buyer skipping is enabled and the subscription is active on a Flint-owned billing schedule (billing_schedule_owner is flint), is not set to cancel at the end of its period, and is under the store's consecutive skip limit. Requires a full buyer session. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

skipSubscriptionCycle.description: While prepaid deliveries remain, defers the next delivery and next charge by one delivery interval without consuming a delivery. Otherwise skips the next renewal without charging or shipping and moves the next billing date forward by one billing interval. A Flint-owned schedule keeps its billing_anchor_day, including when the skipped date falls in a shorter month. Available while the subscription is active, is not set to cancel at the end of its period, and has a next billing date.

startFulfillment.description: Starts fulfillment work. Read supported_actions for actions available now. occurred_at records when the action occurred; on complete it also records completion evidence. expected_version optionally rejects a stale fulfillment version. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

startOnboarding.description: Starts the consolidated onboarding flow by accepting a verification email for asynchronous delivery and returning a temporary verification token. Success does not confirm email delivery.

streamWebhookEvents.description: Streams canonical merchant webhook events created after the connection opens or after the supplied event ID. SSE event IDs are resumable webhook event IDs. Control records include ready, gap, withheld, and disconnect. Gap records indicate cursor_unavailable or payload_expired; withheld records hide payloads the caller cannot read. Backpressure emits disconnect with reason backpressure and resume_cursor identifying the last sent event, so clients can reconnect without losing events. A partner app token streams the installed merchant's events in the environment its grant covers, and sees a payload only for an event Flint forwards to installed-merchant endpoints whose read scope the grant holds; every other event is a withheld record.

undoTicketCheckIn.description: Returns a checked-in ticket to issued and clears checked_in_at and check_in_method. An issued ticket returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied; a voided ticket returns reason unsupported_state.

unfreezeGiftCard.description: Removes a merchant freeze and restores spending. Unresolved funding-dispute restrictions refuse this action. expected_version fences the gift card version.

unsubscribeEmailPreferenceLink.description: Disables the email preference represented by an emailed token without signing the buyer in. Repeating the request keeps it disabled. The merchant key must match the token's merchant and environment.

updateAPIKey.description: Updates an API key's name, access, scopes, or expires_at. Expired keys can be updated, and a future expires_at reactivates one. A revoked key can't be updated. An API key caller may grant only scopes it holds and can manage only keys whose scopes it holds.

updateBundle.description: Applies a sparse update to a bundle: only the fields you send change. Sending `components` replaces the whole list; omitted components are removed. `expected_version` is required when you send `components` or `images`, and a stale version fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT`. A SKU or barcode that another variant or bundle already uses fails with `ALREADY_EXISTS`. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `archived` when the resource, or the parent it belongs to, is archived. The error names the archived resource and its `current_status`.

updateCategory.description: Updates a category's name, description, `external_reference_id`, or metadata. Only the fields you send change; the handle stays the same. Send `expected_version` to reject the update with `VERSION_CONFLICT` when the category changed since you read it.

updateCheckoutSession.description: Updates the mutable fields of a checkout session. A merchant credential can update metadata and external_reference_id, including after the session ends. Send external_reference_id as null to clear it, or metadata as null to clear all metadata. On a session with a subscription_plan_id, either credential can send subscription_terms with the buyer's billing interval and quantity while the session is open and no payment is in progress; a change reprices the signup order and releases the delivery selection. The session's own checkout credential can also send buyer_contact and timezone while the session is open. The buyer_contact field saves the email and phone the buyer entered; send a contact field as null to clear it. The timezone field records the buyer's IANA time zone, which Flint uses for times in the emails it sends the buyer. Saving the same values again changes nothing.

updateCreditNote.description: Updates draft credit note fields and corrections atomically. Omitted fields are unchanged, a null memo clears it, and line_items requires expected_version. Replacing lines recalculates their amounts from current remaining creditable pools. Scalar edits preserve stored line values. Issued and void credit notes are frozen.

updateCustomer.description: Applies a sparse update to a customer. Clearing email while any subscription is not canceled returns 409 CUSTOMER_EMAIL_REQUIRED. Changing, case-changing, or clearing an existing email requires customer_account.mode to be merchant_hosted; otherwise the update fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `managed_externally`. A customer with no email can be given one in either mode. To change the email of a customer who signs in to your Flint-hosted account, create a customer session for the customer and send POST /v1/me/email-change-requests with the new email; the customer confirms it with the codes Flint emails them. If Flint cannot read the account settings, the update fails with a retryable `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` and the customer is unchanged.

updateCustomerAddress.description: Applies a sparse update to a saved address. Set is_default_billing or is_default_shipping to true to make this address the default, or false to clear a default it holds. Updating a default address also updates the customer's effective address for that role.

updateCustomerTaxExemption.description: Updates only fields supplied. Coverage is replaced as a whole and requires expected_version. Null clears optional description, certificate_number, evidence_reference and end_date. Metadata merges by key; null values remove individual keys and a null map clears caller-owned metadata. Expired and archived records reject edits with ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. A stale expected_version returns VERSION_CONFLICT before effects. Retry a lost response with the same request and Idempotency-Key. If IDEMPOTENCY_RECOVERY_REQUIRED is returned, inspect this customer's list and GET records before sending a new write. Match a lost create against submitted fields across list pages; contact support with the original key and request ID if its outcome is unclear.

updateDeliveryLocationSet.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A request that carries configuration publishes a new immutable revision, even when its values are unchanged, and requires expected_version. Other fields advance version and keep the current revision. Archived resources can't be changed; create a new resource instead.

updateDeliveryMethod.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A request that carries configuration, name, description, display_position, or recommendation_priority publishes a new immutable revision, even when its values are unchanged, and requires expected_version. Other fields, such as status, metadata, and external_reference_id, advance version and keep the current revision, so they never replace a revoked revision. Archived resources can't be changed; create a new resource instead. A method referenced by checkout.default_delivery_method_ids at merchant scope or by delivery_method_ids on an active or inactive payment link cannot be set inactive; the request returns 409 RESOURCE_IN_USE with the blocking references. Remove the method from checkout.default_delivery_method_ids with PATCH /v1/settings or from the link's delivery_method_ids with PATCH /v1/payment-links/{payment_link_id}.

updateDeliveryProfile.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. Send is_default true to make this active profile the physical catalog default, together with any other mutable fields in one atomic update. Sending only is_default true for the current default leaves its version unchanged and emits no events. A request that carries configuration publishes a new immutable revision, even when its values are unchanged, and requires expected_version. Other fields advance version and keep the current revision. Archived resources can't be changed; create a new resource instead.

updateDeliveryRateCallback.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A request that carries configuration or signing_methods publishes a new immutable revision, even when its values are unchanged, and requires expected_version. Other fields, such as name, external_reference_id, and status, advance version and keep the current revision, so they never replace a revoked revision. signing_methods replaces the set. Adding hmac when the callback has no shared secret issues one and returns it once, with its delivery_rate_callback_signing_key_id, in this response. Removing hmac deletes all shared secrets. Archived resources can't be changed; create a new resource instead.

updateDeliveryZone.description: Sparsely updates mutable fields. A request that carries configuration publishes a new immutable revision, even when its values are unchanged, and requires expected_version. Other fields advance version and keep the current revision. Archived resources can't be changed; create a new resource instead.

updateDevice.description: Applies a sparse update to a device. Send null to clear location_id or all metadata. The name field cannot be null. Archived devices return ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived.

updateFulfillment.description: Updates mutable fulfillment fields and fulfillment-specific details. Fulfillment line item allocation is set when the fulfillment is created. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied.

updateGiftCard.description: Updates descriptive associations. Omitted fields are preserved; null clears external_reference_id or customer_id. This operation cannot change balances, currency, code or status. expected_version fences the gift card version.

updateInventoryAllocationPolicy.description: Update policy fields, availability, or atomically replace its routing configuration. expected_version is optional and enforced when sent, and is required when replacing configuration. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory allocation policy by ID.

updateInventoryCount.description: Replace a count's complete observation set atomically. expected_version is required when replacing observations. Send every item exactly once with the count's current expected_version and each observation's required expected_physical_version. Read the level before physically counting; zero is valid for a missing level. Every assertion must match locked current stock or the whole save is refused. Preserve saved quantities and fences for unchanged lines. Recount affected items before supplying fresh fences, even when quantities are unchanged. Omitted condition quantities retain the matching level snapshot's values. occurred_at records provenance and does not reconstruct historical stock. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory count by ID.

updateInventoryItem.description: Update an inventory item. Accepts status active or inactive. Send sku or barcode as null to clear. expected_version is optional and enforced when sent. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory item by ID.

updateInventoryLevel.description: Set one inventory level's safety_stock_quantity. expected_version is optional and enforced when sent. The version changes on every quantity or claim change, including holds and commits, so read the level immediately before a PATCH. Returns the updated inventory level. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. To recover the command's effects after a lost response, read the inventory level by ID.

updateInventoryReservation.description: Change the hold deadline of a reservation you created. The new expires_at must be after now and at most 24 hours from now, and can be earlier or later than the current one. A lapsed hold cannot be extended, and reservations Flint holds for orders cannot be changed. Committed and consumed quantity never expire.

updateInventoryTransfer.description: Update an open transfer's planning details. Sending lines replaces the owned collection atomically and requires expected_version. For metadata-only edits, expected_version is optional and enforced when sent. Omitted fields stay unchanged. Send external_reference_id: null to clear it.

updateInvoice.description: Updates mutable fields on a draft invoice. Null is rejected for cc_emails, collection, payment_due, schedule_entries, reminders_paused, and expected_version; omit them to leave them unchanged. Send [] to clear cc_emails or the authored schedule. After issue, the only writable field is reminders_paused, which pauses or resumes automatic reminders on an open or partially paid invoice.

updateInvoicePaymentTerm.description: Update invoice payment term for the authenticated merchant. Null is rejected for name, calculation, and expected_version; omit them to leave them unchanged. Null clears late_fee_policy or external_reference_id.

updateLocation.description: Update a Location's profile, availability, geography, and inventory allocation in one call. Sending inventory_allocation_enabled also requires commerce.inventory.allocation.write. The version advances on every change. expected_version is optional and compared with version when sent. Idempotency is scoped to the authenticated merchant, environment, and endpoint. Its fingerprint includes the canonical request body. An archived Location cannot be changed: the request returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason archived and current_status archived.

updateMe.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Updates the current buyer's name or phone. Manage billing and shipping addresses through /v1/me/addresses. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

updateMeAddress.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. The request cannot select a customer_id. Changes the fields you send on one of the buyer's saved addresses. The address field replaces the whole postal address. Send null for phone or label to remove it. Set is_default_billing or is_default_shipping to true to make this address the default, or false to clear a default it holds. Changing a default address also changes the matching address on the buyer's customer profile. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

updateMeEmailPreferences.description: Uses the customer identity fixed by the customer session. Turns the optional email categories in the body on or off for the customer's current email at this merchant in the selected merchant environment, and leaves the others as they are. The setting follows the email address, so it also covers guest checkouts with the same email. A customer without an email has no email preferences, and the change fails with `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND`.

updateMerchant.description: Applies a sparse update to the authenticated merchant's profile, shared across live and all sandboxes. Every mutable field requires a live-mode credential or a Dashboard session in any selected environment. Test credentials fail with `FORBIDDEN` and reason `live_mode_required`, with one detail per supplied shared field, including nulls and metadata changes. Nothing is saved on refusal. A partner app install token can change only `business_name`, `icon`, and `logo`; another field returns `400 INVALID_REQUEST` with a `NOT_ALLOWED` detail whose `param` names it.

updateMeSubscription.description: Updates payment_method_id, cancel_at_period_end: false, scheduled_plan_change: null, delivery, billing interval and quantity when the matching buyer action is available. Send billing_interval and billing_interval_count together. Mixed changes commit atomically. A scoped card-update session may send only payment_method_id and expected_version. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. A card whose setup hasn't finished fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `status_not_reached`. Once setup finishes, send a new request with a new idempotency key. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

updateMeSubscriptionLineItem.description: Swaps a subscription line to an offered variant for future renewals. Requires a full buyer session. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. The replacement must remain deliverable to the subscription destination. A closed store is read-only: commerce changes fail with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason terminal_status. Receipts and order history remain readable.

updateModifierGroup.description: Applies a sparse update to a modifier group: only the fields you send change. Sending `modifiers` replaces the whole list; modifiers you leave out are archived, and `expected_version` is required with it. A stale version fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT`. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `archived` when the resource, or the parent it belongs to, is archived. The error names the archived resource and its `current_status`.

updateModifierSet.description: Applies a sparse update to a modifier set: only the fields you send change. Sending `modifier_groups` replaces the set's group entries; entries you leave out are removed, and `expected_version` is required with it. A stale version fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT`. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `archived` when the resource, or the parent it belongs to, is archived. The error names the archived resource and its `current_status`.

updateOrder.description: Applies a sparse update to mutable order fields such as customer_id, notes, metadata, tax, the delivery destination, and the requested tip. catalog_price_behavior defaults to keep. Send reprice with an explicit non-null customer_id to refresh every catalog variant line on an open, unpaid order; reassignment resolves the new customer’s direct list, then segment list, then variant prices. Customer removal is not supported. Checkout verification never reprices existing lines. A request containing only metadata, internal_note, buyer_note, or external_reference_id, with optional expected_version, can update open, closed, paid, and invoice-locked orders without changing totals. Other merchant edits keep hosted and headless checkout sessions open unless an edit closes or completes the order, which ends the session with order_mutated. Edits can also end invoice, return-resolution, and subscription-plan sessions with order_mutated. A session already past expires_at ends with expired before the edit is applied. These annotation updates are blocked while any order payment attempt remains non-terminal, including an authorization awaiting capture, or checkout payment work is still resolving. Requests combining annotations with other fields use the financial mutation rules for the entire request. Send requested_tip: null to clear the current requested tip. Once a payment's capture sets its own tip with tip_money, the order's tip is set per payment: setting or clearing requested_tip returns ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason payment_collected. A merchant can correct a paid subscription signup or renewal destination before shipment by sending delivery_destination and the current order version as expected_version. The committed delivery methods must remain eligible, and shipping and tax totals must stay unchanged. When the correction would change the paid totals, the request fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `payment_collected`. The detail can include shipping_money, requoted_shipping_money, tax_money, and requoted_tax_money.

updateOrderCharge.description: Updates a single service charge, fee, or surcharge on an order.

updateOrderLineItem.description: Updates a single line item on an order. On paid orders, send expected_ship_date as a YYYY-MM-DD calendar date or null to clear it. It must be the only field apart from expected_version. expected_version is the order version returned in data.version. Send gift_card_face_value_money and expected_version to select an unpaid gift card line's face value within its frozen offer and reprice the order before any purchase funding. Send gift_card_recipient and expected_version to replace or clear recipient delivery details before any purchase funding. Checkout credentials can update gift card face value and recipient details together, modifiers, or a line subscription offer selection, each with expected_version. Repeating the current gift card face value does not change the order version. Set subscription to null to buy the line once.

updatePackage.description: Updates non-lifecycle package fields such as carrier, tracking, expected_delivery_at, label access, measurements, metadata, and caller-owned external references. Descriptive fields can be corrected until the package is voided, regardless of shipment or fulfillment status. Corrections never email the buyer. Package status cannot be patched directly. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

updatePackageItem.description: Updates a package item quantity or metadata while the package is still mutable.

updatePartnerApp.description: Updates a partner app owned by the authenticated merchant. Send only the fields to change. permission_manifest replaces the whole manifest and requires expected_version. An existing permission can drop scopes but not gain them; removing or narrowing a permission narrows existing environment grants immediately, and tokens issued with the removed scopes stop working. Adding a permission changes no install until the merchant authorizes again. Setting client_secret_enabled to true issues a first secret when secret authentication is disabled; only this response and its same-credential idempotent replay return that secret. Setting false ends current and previous secrets immediately. A Dashboard session needs fresh identity verification to enable secret authentication, including on replay.

updatePaymentIntent.description: Applies a sparse update while status is requires_payment_method, requires_confirmation, requires_action, or requires_capture. In processing, succeeded, canceled, or expired it fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `in_progress` or `terminal_status`, with the status in `error.details[].current_status`. amount_money can change only while status is requires_payment_method and before the first confirmation attempt; after that, create a new payment intent. customer_id can change only while status is requires_payment_method, and receipt_email only while it is requires_payment_method or requires_confirmation. Send null to clear tip_money, external_reference_id, receipt_email, or all metadata; amount_money and customer_id cannot be cleared. Order-owned intents accept only metadata and external_reference_id; amount_money, tip_money, customer_id, and receipt_email return INVALID_REQUEST with one NOT_ALLOWED detail per field. This route doesn't attach a payment source: send the buyer's credential to the confirm route.

updatePaymentLink.description: Updates a payment link. To replace line items, custom fields, or delivery methods, send the complete array with `expected_version`.

updatePaymentMethodDomain.description: Turns the domain on or off. Reads never check again with the provider; they return the last result. Sending status active registers the hostname on your current payment account, turns it on, and checks again any wallet that isn't active, so send it to check a domain again. Sending status inactive turns wallet buttons off for the hostname.

updatePayoutDestination.description: Updates mutable metadata and settings for a payout destination. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key.

updatePayoutSettings.description: Updates mutable payout settings for the authenticated merchant, including the default payout destination for each currency. Changing defaults requires expected_version, and each new default must be an active destination in its currency. Safe to retry with the same idempotency key.

updatePriceList.description: Updates only the fields supplied. Send customer_segments: [] to clear segment assignments. Inactive lists remain assignable but do not provide prices. Send expected_version to reject a stale write. Archived lists cannot be changed.

updatePriceListPrice.description: Updates a variant price or its quantity schedule. Omit quantity_price_breaks to preserve it; send [] to clear it. The resulting complete schedule must remain valid. expected_version fences this child price; an actual change also advances the parent list version once.

updateProduct.description: Applies a sparse update to product-parent fields. When category_handles is present, it replaces the full category list; send [] to clear it. Sellable price, SKU, and inventory live on variants. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `archived` when the resource, or the parent it belongs to, is archived. The error names the archived resource and its `current_status`.

updateProductVariant.description: Applies a sparse update to a variant: only the fields you send change. A SKU or barcode that another variant or bundle already uses, or an option combination that another variant selects, fails with `ALREADY_EXISTS`. Changes to name, price, SKU, and similar fields apply to new checkouts, links, and plans; existing orders keep what they were charged. Setting the variant inactive, or changing its price currency, fails with `RESOURCE_IN_USE` while an open order, checkout session, active payment link, subscription, subscription plan, or active bundle uses it. Send `expected_version` to reject the update when the variant changed since you read it. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `archived` when the resource, or the parent it belongs to, is archived. The error names the archived resource and its `current_status`.

updatePromotion.description: Applies a sparse update to promotion fields. application_method, schedule, exclusivity, and combines_with patch by subfield presence. Omitted fields retain stored values; null clears only nullable fields. Sending a different application_method.type replaces the effect while preserving omitted shared settings, including discounted_item_rules. A redeemed promotion can't change its `discount_class` or `application_method` type; the update fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `field_locked`. Archived promotions cannot be changed. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `archived` when the resource, or the parent it belongs to, is archived. The error names the archived resource and its `current_status`.

updatePromotionCode.description: Applies a sparse update to a promotion code. Fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `archived` when the resource, or the parent it belongs to, is archived. The error names the archived resource and its `current_status`.

updateReader.description: Changes a reader's `name`, `device_id` (`null` clears it) and `metadata` (merged by key). A reader's `type` and `location_id` never change: to move a reader, archive it and register it again at the new location. An archived reader can't change. Sends `reader.updated`.

updateReturn.description: Update caller-owned fields on a Return. Only external_reference_id and metadata are writable. Send optional expected_version to reject a stale Return version; every other change goes through a decision, operation, or resolution command.

updateReturnLineItem.description: Update a requested Return line item. Send null to clear buyer_note or requested_resolution_type. The response is the updated Return.

updateReturnPolicy.description: Update policy identity fields or set status to active or inactive. Rules live on revisions, so changing a window, fee, or scope means publishing a new revision.

updateReturnReason.description: Update a Return reason. Send null to clear description. A present category_handles array replaces the existing set. Set status to active or inactive to control availability. Flint reasons accept only status and expected_version; create your own reason to use different wording. Use DELETE to archive a merchant reason.

updateReturnResolution.description: Update a proposed resolution before confirmation. A present line_items, replacement_line_items, or adjustments array replaces that collection and requires expected_version.

updateRiskList.description: Renames a list you created. Flint-managed lists fail with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `managed_externally`. Items can still be added to and removed from active Flint-managed lists.

updateRiskRule.description: Changes a rule's action, predicate, description, or status, and increases its version. Send expected_version to avoid overwriting another edit. Flint's default rules accept only status. Activating a rule validates it again.

updateSettings.description: Applies a sparse patch to merchant settings. See each field for how it is patched. A partner app install token can't send `checkout.enabled_payment_options`, `customer_account.buyer_capabilities`, `inventory.origin_policies`, `invoices.autopay_retry_policy`, `invoices.default_collection_mode`, `invoices.default_invoice_payment_term_id`, `invoices.payment_policy`, `invoices.remit_to_address`, `payment_limits`, `payments.statement_descriptor`, `subscriptions.default_billing_schedule_owner`, `subscriptions.dunning_end_action`, `subscriptions.dunning_retry_days`, `subscriptions.external_dunning_end_action`, `tax`, or `tax_identity`, or null for `checkout`, `customer_account`, `inventory`, `invoices`, or `subscriptions`; each returns `400 INVALID_REQUEST` with a `NOT_ALLOWED` detail whose `param` names the field.

updateShipment.description: Updates shipment metadata and caller-owned external references. Shipment status is derived from package statuses and cannot be patched directly. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied.

updateSubscription.description: Updates metadata, external_reference_id, payment_method_id, delivery, billing interval, quantity, cancel_at_period_end: false to undo a scheduled cancellation, or scheduled_plan_change: null to keep the current plan. Send billing_interval and billing_interval_count together. A billing_schedule update must be the only mutable field. Delivery, cadence and quantity changes apply to future unpaid renewals. Send expected_version to reject concurrent changes. Schedule a cancellation with POST /v1/subscriptions/{subscription_id}/cancel, change the plan with /change-plan, and manage lines through the line-items collection. A card whose setup hasn't finished fails with `ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED` and reason `status_not_reached`. Once setup finishes, send a new request with a new idempotency key.

updateSubscriptionLineItem.description: Updates a subscription line for future renewals. Send expected_version to reject a concurrent change. Already-created orders keep their lines.

updateSubscriptionOffer.description: Update subscription offer. Offer changes affect new signups only. Existing subscriptions keep their terms.

updateSubscriptionPlan.description: Applies a sparse update to mutable subscription plan fields. Setting status to inactive returns RESOURCE_IN_USE while active payment links use the plan. Open checkout sessions do not block this change; buyers in those sessions are refused with ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED when they pay. Send line_items with expected_version to replace the plan's line items; omit line_items to keep them.

updateTaxCalculationCallback.description: Tax calculation callback configuration is scoped to the selected environment. Partner installation tokens are unsupported. Configuration and signing-method changes require expected_version and publish an immutable revision. Configuration fields are patched individually. Change status on its own. A callback selected by tax.calculation_callback_id cannot be deactivated.

updateTaxRegistration.description: Updates locally without a tax-account call. Pending and rejected registrations allow registration_number, start_date and end_date; registration_number and start_date require a connection that is not active. Scheduled and active registrations allow only end_date. A pending or rejected registration whose tax-account copy exists or may have been created cannot change start_date; delete it and create it again. Ended registrations cannot be changed. End_date must be on or after start_date and today (UTC); null clears it before the registration ends. Date windows in the same state cannot overlap. To replace an active registration number, set its end_date, then create a replacement starting the next day. Changing end_date does not invalidate calculations made today. An empty patch is invalid.

updateTicket.description: Sets the attendee name. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed; send null to clear the name. Sending the current name changes nothing and keeps the version. A voided ticket returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason unsupported_state.

updateWebhookEndpoint.description: Updates a webhook endpoint's URL, description, status, subscribed events, event sources, signing methods, or pinned API version. Only the fields you send change. Sending `enabled_events`, `event_sources`, `installed_merchant_modes`, or `signing_methods` replaces that whole list and requires `expected_version`; a stale version fails with `VERSION_CONFLICT`. Adding `hmac` when no secret exists issues the first secret and returns it once. Removing `hmac` deletes all shared secrets. Partner-source endpoints are global configuration. Changes to them or their events and deliveries require a live-mode credential or a Dashboard session, including test events and endpoints subscribed only to test installed-merchant events. Test credentials fail with `FORBIDDEN` and reason `live_mode_required`, including on idempotent replay.

updateWorkloadIdentity.description: Updates mutable policy fields. expected_version is optional for scalar updates and required when claim_conditions or scopes is supplied. Arrays replace their entire value. Issuer and audience are immutable. Dashboard callers reactivating or widening live identities need fresh identity verification.

validateCustomDomain.description: Starts provider and DNS checks for this domain. Send no body or an empty JSON object. Checks are limited to once every 60 seconds per domain; a request over that limit fails with `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, so wait before validating again.

verifyMerchantSignup.description: Uses the owner's code and their acceptance of Flint's merchant terms, then creates the merchant, installs the app on it in the signup's modes, and returns one authorization code per mode. Exchange each at POST /v1/oauth/token with the code_verifier for the signup's code_challenge and without redirect_uri, within 5 minutes. Checks, in order, before any effect: the signup is pending (409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied when completed, unsupported_state with current_status otherwise); the app's create_merchants capability again; the attempt caps (409 LIMIT_REACHED with reason verification_attempts: 5 wrong codes use up a code, and wrong codes for one owner mailbox are capped at 10 per 24 hours and 30 per 7 days, with resets_at); the code. A wrong, expired or replaced code is 400 INVALID_REQUEST with INVALID_VALUE at verification_code. After the code matches, an owner Flint can't use is refused with 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED and reason owner_identity_conflict (the owner contacts Flint support, then you resend a code or start a new signup), and an owner who already owns 10 active merchants with 409 LIMIT_REACHED and reason owned_merchants. Completion is resumable. Once the code is used, Flint finishes creating the merchant even if this request fails; a failure returns 503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE. Send verify again, with the same Idempotency-Key or a new one and the same code, to wait for or continue the same completion and get the result. An idempotent replay returns the signup without the codes: mint new ones with rotate-authorization-codes. Live only: test credentials get 403 FORBIDDEN with reason live_mode_required, and a key linked to a partner app install gets 403 FORBIDDEN with reason linked_key_not_allowed. Partner app tokens can't call it.

verifyOnboardingEmail.description: Verifies the emailed code, provisions the Flint user and merchant if needed, and returns an onboarding session token. The token expires at onboarding_session_expires_at and cannot be refreshed. Verify the email again to get a new one. Read GET /v1/onboarding/state next.

verifyReturnReceiptLineItem.description: Establish the Return line identity for receipt quantity that arrived without one. expected_version compares against the receipt version. Unverified quantity counts toward no line and releases no release timing gate until it is verified.

voidCreditNote.description: Voids an issued credit note. Reverse every allocation first. A credit note with a pending or succeeded refund can't be voided. Blockers fail with `RESOURCE_IN_USE`, and `details[0].blocking_resources` lists the allocations and refunds. Void is terminal, and an invoice cannot be voided while an issued credit note stands against it.

voidInvoice.description: Voids an unpaid invoice and releases its collection authority. For a Quick Pay invoice, also closes the order with closed_reason invoice_voided only when it is open with no collected payment and no fulfillment. Otherwise the order is unchanged. An invoice with an issued credit note against it cannot be voided until that credit note is voided.

voidPackage.description: Voids a package before carrier handoff and appends a package timeline event. Voided package items no longer count against fulfillment package allocation capacity. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

voidShipment.description: Voids a shipment before carrier handoff and voids all child packages that have not shipped. The action appends timeline events for the shipment and affected packages. expected_version is optional and rejects a stale resource version when supplied. Read timeline events with GET /v1/fulfillment-events filtered by package_id, shipment_id, or fulfillment_id, and notifications with GET /v1/fulfillment-notifications filtered by fulfillment_event_id or fulfillment_id.

voidTicket.description: Permanently voids an issued or checked-in ticket and releases its seat: the payment link's total_quantity_sold drops by one in the same transaction. Like a refund release, this doesn't change the link's version or send payment_link.updated. Nothing is refunded and the order's ticketed_event doesn't change. A later full refund of the order releases only its remaining valid tickets. A voided ticket returns 409 ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED with reason already_applied.

waiveInvoiceLateFee.description: Waives the unpaid remainder of an assessed late fee. Collected money is not refunded. The reason is visible only to the merchant.

waiveReturnLineItemInspection.description: Waive the inspection requirement on a Return line item so received quantity can be dispositioned and resolved without an inspection observation. Received quantity on a waived line satisfies after_inspection release timing.
